Alienism.description: The Alienism faith is a group of related beliefs that hold that vastly powerful godlike beings live in the far reaches of space. The existence of these beings partially overlaps with neighboring dimensions and other periods of time. These beings are immensely powerful forces of an unimaginable nature, though generally malicious, who have a desire to rule over all living things. Alienism is an enigmatic faith. Unlike most Faith FX broad skills that use rituals to call the attention of benign powers and beseech their aid, Alienism uses rituals to channel the power of old gods without needing their attention or permission. Even those who work against these beings can use these rituals to great effect. Anyone dabbling in these powers risks undergoing psychological changes, and eventually even madness, due to the bizarre and unfathomable nature of the beings from which this power is drawn.
Alienism.name: Alienism
Alienism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 36-37

Body Alteration.description: The Body Alteration Super Power FX broad skill is a collection of Super Power FX that alter a hero's form or how a hero interacts with other physical matter. Size changes, shape alteration, extra arms, stretching, invisibility, and passing through solid objects are all powers of this type. Depending upon the power, the hero may simply have an unusual body shape, have fine control over the elasticity and form of his tissues, or may be able to alter the consistency of his flesh on an atomic level. Body Alteration powers require either a high Will to initiate and control these changes or a high Constitution to endure the stresses they place upon the body.
Body Alteration.name: Body Alteration
Body Alteration.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 58

Brick.description: The Brick Super Power FX broad skill is a collection of abilities that enhance the body's ability to resist and cause damage. Many super villains are nothing more than brutes with incredible strength who can shrug off bullets. However, the Brick powers are the backbone of many comic book heroes as well, whether these powers originate from a high-tech suit of armor, obvious morphological changes such as rocklike skin, or being made of fundamentally denser materials. In some campaigns, Brick powers are so readily available that any people with the right connections—or even just a lot of money—can have themselves made into a superior physical specimen. Brick characters are likely to have a high Strength and Constitution. Most Brick powers are automatic or always active. Those that require activation are often Will-based.
Brick.name: Brick
Brick.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 61

Chi.description: The Chi Super Power FX broad skill represents enhancement to the character's body and mind brought about by discipline and training. Most sorts of fantastic martial arts movies and comic book characters that exhibit exceptional but not superpowered abilities can be modeled with Chi FX. Practitioners of Chi are very dedicated individuals. They have devoted their lives to a religion, a cause, or a form of martial art. Chi powers take years to develop, and so most characters are not able to pick them up during the course of a normal campaign. Some are more powerful versions of other abilities available to characters. Non-Chi characters can reproduce some of a Chi master's incredible abilities to a lesser extent through perks and rank benefits. Some Chi Super Power FX specialty skills note that no skill check is required for their use. These include skills that merely augment a hero's other skills, such as mighty leap (Athletics-jump) and power climb (Athletics-climb). The practitioner of Chi relies on the power of her body as well as her mind. Thus, Chi specialty skills are based on Strength or Will.
Chi.name: Chi
Chi.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 63

Diabolism.description: Diabolism is the arcane practice of interacting with, summoning, and controlling entities from other dimensions, typically referred to as demons, fiends, or spirits. Unlike Faith FX, which relies on prayer and divine alignment, Diabolism treats these interactions as precise formulas, binding extra-dimensional entities through occult geometry, true names, and sheer force of will. It is a highly dangerous school of magic; errors in protective circles or formulas can result in the summoner being attacked or possessed by the very entity they sought to control.
Diabolism.meta: Cost: 12 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Will
Diabolism.name: Diabolism
Diabolism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 22

Druidism.description: The druidic faith is a belief that the earth is the mother and source of all life. The faith reveres the earth and other natural things, observing and maintaining the circle of life, death, and rebirth. The miracles of Druidism require a combination of understanding how the pathways of natural energy work and sufficient will to manipulate those pathways to result in physical changes.
Druidism.name: Druidism

Energy.description: The Energy Super Power FX broad skill deals mainly with the creation, destruction, and control of energy, including thermal (heat or cold), electrical, and radioactive energy. Beings with these abilities tend to be very impressive, throwing lightning bolts or shielding themselves in cloaks of fire, but also have a great potential to inflict damage. Like the Brick Super Power FX broad skill, the Energy FX broad skill can manifest in many different ways and result from varied story origins, such as lasers from an advanced body tank, the bolts from an electrokinetic mutant, or the breath of a creature whose home dimension is made of fire. Energy Super Power FX skills generally rely on the hero's Will to shape the energy, though a high Constitution is also useful.
Energy.name: Energy
Energy.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 64

Hatire.description: The Hatire faith developed in the STAR DRIVE campaign setting as a group of people who eschewed the use of technology and embraced the idea of hard work for the benefit of all in the community. This religion became somewhat popular and eventually had a following large enough to populate a planetary colony. During the exploration of their new planet, Haven, the Hatire discovered ancient ruins that spoke of a deity—called the Cosimir—worshiped by the planet's former inhabitants. This being was a proponent of purity of spirit, an ideal that the Hatire also held. The Hatire combined the worship of the Cosimir into their own religion and continued their work in their region of space. Reflecting the Hatire mores of perseverance, patience, and continuous striving, Hatire miracles are easier to invoke if some time is spent in prayer before invoking the miracle. If a Hatire priest spends an entire round in prayer before invoking the miracle, the priest enjoys a -1 step bonus to the miracle's skill check. If the priest can spend a full 10 minutes in prayer, he gains a -3 step bonus to invoke the miracle. The priest must maintain concentration during this time, or the miracle and any FX points used to activate it are lost. Any damage suffered during this period or any actions taken other than prayer immediately break concentration. The Hatire faith is a splinter group of a monotheistic religion. Therefore, the use of Hatire Faith FX requires strong Will and Personality Abilities similar to the Monotheism Faith FX, and its miracles are based on those two Ability Scores.
Hatire.name: Hatire
Hatire.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 43-44

Hemomancy.description: Hemomancy, or blood magic, is an ancient and taboo school of arcane magic that manipulates the vital life force residing within a creature's blood. Unlike traditional sorcery that shapes ambient dimensional energy, Hemomancy requires a physical sacrifice, forcing the caster to use their own vital essence—or the stolen blood of others—to fuel powerful transformations, generate violent physical frenzies, or inflict direct biological harm. Practitioners often exhibit a cold, detached disposition, and over-reliance on these dark arts can leave a spellcaster permanently drained or physically altered.
Hemomancy.meta: Cost: 12 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Constitution
Hemomancy.name: Hemomancy
Hemomancy.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 25

Hermeticism.description: Hermeticism is the traditional school of alchemy, material transmutation, and artificial life construction. Rooted in rigorous scientific formulas and esoteric equations, hermetic wizards view the universe as a complex clockwork mechanism of interacting elements that can be broken down, rewritten, and reassembled. Through precise geometric circles, alchemical reagents, and intense mental focus, a hermetic magus can transmute base materials into precious or weaponized substances, forge absolute mystical bonds between disparate objects, reshape physical anatomy, or breathe rudimentary life into artificial vessels.
Hermeticism.meta: Cost: 11 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Will
Hermeticism.name: Hermeticism
Hermeticism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 27

Illusion.description: The Illusion school of arcane magic specializes in tricking the senses of observers. Unlike physical transformations or energy manipulation, illusions alter light and sound waves, or plant sensory phantasms directly into the minds of targets. While these creations possess no actual physical mass or ability to inflict real structural damage, they are indistinguishable from reality unless closely investigated or exposed by supernatural senses.
Illusion.meta: Cost: 9 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Personality
Illusion.name: Illusion
Illusion.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 29

Mesmerism.description: The Mesmerism school of arcane magic is dedicated to manipulating, controlling, and altering the minds, perceptions, and emotions of living subjects. Unlike illusion magic, which primarily alters external light and sound waves, mesmerism targets the neurological and spiritual pathways of the victim's brain directly. A skilled mesmerist can weave subtle suggestions into a target's thoughts, lull them into vulnerable trance states, command their physical movements, or shatter their mental resilience entirely.
Mesmerism.meta: Cost: 10 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Personality
Mesmerism.name: Mesmerism
Mesmerism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 31

Metaconscious.description: While the Super Power FX Body Alteration broad skill deals with changes to a hero's body or physical interactions, the Metaconscious broad skill expands the hero's non-physical attributes and awareness of his or her surroundings. Heightened Intelligence, Will, and Personality, rapid absorption of knowledge, and enhanced senses are all part of this broad skill. These powers are all based on superior will or cognitive ability and rely upon Will or Intelligence to function.
Metaconscious.name: Metaconscious
Metaconscious.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 66

Monotheism.description: Stemming from the belief in an all-powerful deity who created the world, monotheistic faiths (including Christianity, Judaism, and Islam) are rich in tales of the supernatural. Their theological histories include stories of angelic visitation, celestial impregnation, spontaneous healing, and all sorts of transformative miracles. In the context of Faith FX, a monotheistic priest acts as a pure vessel or intermediary, funneling divine cosmic architecture to shift the local matrix. Invoking these wonders requires immense focus and character.
Monotheism.meta: Cost: 10 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Personality
Monotheism.name: Monotheism
Monotheism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Movement.description: The Movement Super Power FX broad skill covers various special abilities that allow the user to move in nonstandard or accelerated ways. Superhuman speed, flight, rapid attacks, and even teleportation are possible with the specialty skills in this group. While flight and swimming are often granted due to simple physiological changes, such as wings or fins, and teleportation works by bending space or breaking dimensional barriers, the other sorts of powers under this broad skill usually originate from a highly accelerated metabolism or the ability to interact with the real world on a different time scale. Most Movement specialty skills do not require a skill check to use. Those that do require one rely on Constitution or Will to activate the power.
Movement.name: Movement
Movement.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 67-68

Necromancy.description: Necromancy is the dark arcane art of manipulating the forces of death, the spirits of the deceased, and the negative energy that animates corpses. Necromancers are often feared and shunned, as their spells deal directly with the violation of the natural order of life and death. Through these macabre rituals, a necromancer can animate mindless zombies from remains, converse with the departed, summon minor ghosts to haunt enemies, knit flesh back together through negative energy, inflict ancient curses, or even tear the soul from a living host.
Necromancy.meta: Cost: 12 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Will
Necromancy.name: Necromancy
Necromancy.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 33

Pyromancy.description: Pyromancy is the highly destructive arcane art of conjuring, controlling, and extinguishing fire and extreme heat. Pyromancers are often volatile and aggressive, commanding the raw elemental fury of flame to incinerate their enemies, protect themselves with shields of fire, or set explosive arcane traps. As fire is a chaotic and hungry element, it requires immense mental discipline to control once unleashed, preventing it from consuming the caster along with their targets.
Pyromancy.meta: Cost: 11 skill points / Governing Abilities: Intelligence, Will
Pyromancy.name: Pyromancy
Pyromancy.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 35

Shamanism.description: The shaman is a holy man, a guide and adviser to a tribe who is gifted with the ability to send her consciousness into the spirit world at will and interact with the creatures there. This ability to accomplish what most can only do accidentally in dreams gives the shaman strength in the spirit world, allowing her to rouse the spirits of the dead, see the future, and enlist the aid of animal spirits.
Shamanism.meta: Cost: 10 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Intelligence
Shamanism.name: Shamanism
Shamanism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 46

Taoism.description: Taoism is a belief system focused on living in perfect harmony with the "Tao" (the Way), the fundamental flow and life force of the universe. Practitioners emphasize balance, naturalness, and internal alchemy, learning to master their own spiritual energy (Chi) to perform exceptional feats of physical and mental resilience. Through dedication and alignment with natural laws, Taoist priests can manipulate their inner energies to heal wounds, project protective spirals of energy, withstand hostile external conditions, or neutralize harmful forces without active resistance.
Taoism.meta: Cost: 13 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Personality
Taoism.name: Taoism
Taoism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 50

Voodoo.description: The Voodoo faith is a syncretic religion centered around the veneration of and communication with the Loa—powerful spirit intermediaries that govern various aspects of nature, humanity, and the cosmos. Practitioners, known as houngans (priests) and mambos (priestesses), use ritual music, dance, and sacred symbols (veves) to enter altered states of consciousness, allowing the Loa to temporarily "ride" or possess their physical bodies to dispense wisdom, protection, or judgment. Rather than viewing the spirit world as separate from reality, the Voodoo faith treats both realms as continuously overlapping matrices. Through these ritual alignments, practitioners can create powerful protective charms, invoke deep physical restoration, cure toxic ailments, or direct targeted spiritual afflictions against hostile forces.
Voodoo.meta: Cost: 12 skill points / Governing Abilities: Will, Personality
Voodoo.name: Voodoo
Voodoo.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 53

Animal voice.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This miracle allows the shaman to speak the language of a specific animal and communicate with it directly, understanding its replies. Dialogue is strictly limited by the animal's cognitive capabilities and current environmental experiences.
Animal voice.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Animal voice.name: Animal voice

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, higher ranks increase the duration of the communication.

Animal voice.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 46

Animate dead.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This spell imbues one or more dead bodies with enough life energy to allow them movement and rudimentary reactions. It can revive a single creature with the approximate brain size of a human or multiple creatures whose combined brain mass doesn't exceed this amount. The animated zombies follow simple verbal commands from the necromancer but have no true intelligence.
Animate dead.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Animate dead.name: Animate dead

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the necromancer can animate and control up to five human-sized corpses simultaneously.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, any zombie animated by the necromancer gains a permanent +2 bonus to its Strength and Constitution scores, making them more durable and deadly in combat.

Animate dead.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 33

Aura.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The +2 resistance modifier dynamically updates the character's base defense profile against active incoming broad skills. Shifted attitudes of observers to Fanatic must be roleplayed accordingly by supporting cast members. Full Text: This miracle surrounds the priest with an invisible aura of divine energy. This aura provides a +2 resistance modifier to all attacks against the priest (melee, ranged, psionic, and FX). Furthermore, all people viewing the priest automatically have their attitude shifted one step toward Fanatic.
Aura.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)
Aura.name: Aura

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, it increases further to d4 points of mortal damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the aura gains the ability to inflict d4 wound damage upon creatures of tainted or infernal origin.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, this damage increases to d8 points of wound damage.

Aura.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Ayza rides.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Ayza is the protector Loa of fields, public spaces, and structural stability. Invoking this miracle grants the priest or a touched ally an exceptional center of gravity and physical resilience. While active, the target receives a -2 step bonus to all Stamina-resist pain checks and physical feat checks meant to resist falling, being knocked prone, or being forcefully moved against their will by external kinetic impacts.
Ayza rides.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Ayza rides.name: Ayza rides

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the stability step bonus improves to -3.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the target gains a permanent +1 to their Strength resistance modifier while the miracle is active.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum duration of the stability effect is extended up to 1 hour per invocation.

Ayza rides.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 54

Ayza's juju.description: This miracle invokes the watchful eye of Ayza, a protector loa. At any time during the miracle's effect, the houngan or mambo can choose to have Ayza intervene in his or her favor. This intervention ends the miracle immediately and acts exactly like a last resort point being spent by the hero.
Ayza's juju.name: Ayza's juju

Bend space.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Any mortal being undergoing this transport must make a mental resolve skill check with a -2 step bonus or temporarily suffer the penalties described in the Alienism description (Gain one flaw, and lose 1 point from Intelligence) lasting for d4 days. All those to be transported must be in physical contact with one another. This miracle causes space to behave in a manner inconsistent with normal geometry, allowing the alienist to travel vast distances in the blink of an eye. Travel in this fashion is instantaneous in terms of this reality, although to those traveling it seems to take anywhere from a few seconds to 2 hours (Roll 3d20 and multiply them together for the number of internal subjective seconds). The sights and sounds experienced during transit are traumatic. The alienist can transport up to 4 people including himself to any point within 100 kilometers that he has previously seen.
Bend space.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Summon miracle (2 FX energy points)
Bend space.name: Bend Space

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, it extends to 1 million kilometers (easily from the Earth to the Moon).
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the alienist can travel anywhere within 1,000 kilometers.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the alienist can transport an additional four people.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, his range extends to 10,000 kilometers.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the alienist can transport an additional four people.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, it increases to 100,000 kilometers (effectively any point on Earth).

Bend space.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 37-38

Binding.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This spell allows the diabolist to bind a summoned extra-dimensional entity to a physical object, a specific location, or a mortal host. The target entity must typically be contained within a protective circle during the casting. A contested check against the entity's mental resolve is required. A successful binding forces the creature to remain anchored to the object or location, or obey a specific passive condition, for the duration of the spell.
Binding.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Binding.name: Binding

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the binding becomes semi-permanent, lasting until explicitly dispelled or broken by an external FX power.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the physical anchor is extended to 24 hours.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the diabolist can bind the entity to a living host, requiring a secondary physical resolve check from the host if unwilling.

Binding.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 22

Black warding.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The diabolist surrounds themselves with a faint field of shimmering dark purple light. This arcane barrier acts as a protective ward against both physical combat and extra-dimensional interference. When active, the ward provides Ordinary toughness armor (d4 points of protection) and grants a +1 bonus to resistance modifiers against any attacks or spellcasting originating from demonic or extra-dimensional beings.
Black warding.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (1 FX energy point)
Black warding.name: Black warding

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, any extra-dimensional creature attempting a physical melee attack against the diabolist suffers d4 stun damage from touching the corruptive ward.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the armor protection provided by the dark light improves to d4+1.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the barrier's resistance modifier against extra-dimensional entities increases to +2.

Black warding.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 16

Blessing.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The -1 step bonus directly acts upon action check thresholds for the scene. Will resistance modifiers apply to mental intrusion defenses. Full Text: This miracle gives indirect aid to the priest and any of her allies within 10 meters. All people affected gain a -1 step bonus to their action checks and a +1 to their Will resistance modifiers for the remainder of the scene.
Blessing.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Blessing.name: Blessing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the miracle affects all allies within the hero's line of sight.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the effect increases to a -2 step bonus and +2 to Will resistance modifiers.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the miracle's area of effect increases to a 100-meter radius.

Blessing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Blood debt.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: The hemomancer binds their life force to a target, transferring incoming physical suffering. When the hemomancer suffers wound or stun damage, they can invoke this spell to pass a portion of that damage directly to a bonded target within 10 meters. The target can resist with a physical resolve check. Full Text: This spell establishes an invisible, parasitic biological link between the caster and a victim, forcing the victim to pay the physical toll for the caster's injuries.
Blood debt.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Blood debt.name: Blood debt

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the link becomes bidirectional, allowing the caster to choose to siphon away a willing ally's damage to protect them from harm.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the range of the biological link increases to 20 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the caster can transfer up to 50% of incoming mortal damage to the bonded victim.

Blood debt.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 25

Bloodlust.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Also known as Blood Rage. The caster overclocks their circulatory system, entering a violent, hyper-focused combat frenzy. While active, the hemomancer gains a -2 step bonus to all melee combat skills and an additional +2 points to melee damage rolls, but suffers a +1 step penalty to all defensive maneuvers and intellectual skill checks. This effect lasts for the duration of the combat scene.
Bloodlust.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Bloodlust.name: Bloodlust

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the melee damage bonus increases to +4 points.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the step bonus to melee attacks improves to -3.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hemomancer becomes completely immune to stun point loss while the frenzy remains active.

Bloodlust.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 25

Body Armor.description: This power makes the character more resistant to all sorts of damage. The body armor provides Ordinary toughness protection equal to d6+1 (LI), d6 (HI), d4 (En). Body armor is usually selected as always active, though some heroes prefer to remain incognito, in which case each activation lasts 10 minutes. If selected as always active, the player can reduce the permanent FX energy point cost from 3 to 2 by stating that the armor represents a significant change in the hero's basic form, such as rocky skin, rigid plates, and so forth.
Body Armor.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Body Armor.name: Body Armor

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, it becomes Good toughness.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the armor improves to d6+2 (LI), d6+1 (HI), d4+1 (En).
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the armor protection becomes d8+2 (LI), d8+1 (HI), d6+1 (En).

Body Armor.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 62

Body and soul.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Resistance modifiers do not alter the righteous wrath skill check. Righteous wrath ignores any armor worn by the targets. Any target with cybernetics or other artificial implants suffers an additional 2 points of stun damage, while those of the Hatire faith reduce all damage suffered by 2 points. (The damage to cybernetics users does not apply to mechalus equipped with only their free cybernetic gear.) Full Text: This miracle directs a barrage of mystical energy at the priest's opponents. The priest makes a single skill check against all targets within a 5-meter-radius sphere centered on any point within 30 meters of him. All within this area suffer damage of d4s/d6s/d8s (En/O).
Body and soul.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Body and soul.name: Body and soul

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the area of effect increases to a 10-meter-radius sphere.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, this miracle inflicts +1 damage on all results.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, this becomes +2 damage.

Body and soul.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 44-45

Call the sky father.description: Changes local weather in a 30-meter-radius area centered on the druid for 10 minutes. The druid can warm or cool the air, disperse or gather small clouds, speed or slow wind, or cause rain to fall or cease, but cannot create weather inappropriate for the terrain and climate. The check is always complex with one roll per round. Common seasonal weather requires an Ordinary complex check, unusual or adjacent-season weather requires Good, and any possible weather for the terrain regardless of season requires Amazing. The Gamemaster sets exact successes required. If conditions support lightning, the druid may spend 1 additional FX energy point to strike a target within 30 meters with a weaker lightning hazard; the target receives a -2 step bonus to the Constitution feat check. This lightning can be used no more than once per minute.
Call the sky father.meta: Manual: Call the Sky Father; Faith FX - Druidism; Specialty cost 5; Ability INT; Transform miracle; 2 FX energy points; Beyond Science p. 40.
Call the sky father.name: Call the sky father

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, duration and radius double again.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Duration and Area - the duration and radius double, including lightning-strike range.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, duration and radius double again.

Child of the earth mother.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Material Restrictions: Invoking this miracle on worked stone (like a statue) inflicts a +1 step penalty. Invoking it on manufactured aggregate stone-like material (like bricks or concrete) inflicts a +2 step penalty. Duration Boosting: Each additional FX energy point spent at invocation increases the elemental's duration by 50%. Full Text: This miracle focuses energy into a piece of stone, giving it mobility and limited intelligence. The created creature, called an earth elemental, is slow but strong. It unquestioningly obeys the orders of the druid who summoned it. The elemental can be used to move objects, dig or fill holes, act as an ally in combat, or perform similar raw physical tasks. The miracle lasts 10 minutes plus 10 minutes for every degree of success of the skill check.
Child of the earth mother.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Child of the earth mother.name: Child of the earth mother
Child of the earth mother.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 41

Circle of the thousand broken angles.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: The circle lasts 5 rounds. No creatures of Alienism origin can cross the circle, nor can any of their FX powers do so. However, such a creature can break the circle by spending five times as many FX energy points as were used to build it. This miracle wards against the servitors of the Alienism powers. It can be used to guard a person from an external threat or to contain a creature. Although it costs only 1 FX energy point to create the 2-meter-radius circle, the alienist can expend additional points at the time of its creation to make a stronger barrier.
Circle of the thousand broken angles.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)
Circle of the thousand broken angles.name: Circle of the Thousand Broken Angles

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the duration increases to 300 rounds (1 hour).
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the duration increases to 15 rounds (3 minutes).
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the duration increases to 50 rounds (10 minutes).
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the duration increases to 150 rounds (30 minutes).

Circle of the thousand broken angles.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 38

Clamor.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: Also known as Cacophony. This spell allows the illusionist to create a localized auditory trick, manufacturing sounds that can range from a hushed whisper right next to a target's ear to the roaring approach of a military transport vehicle. The source of the sound can be placed anywhere within 30 meters and can move about within that radius. A target can make an Awareness-perception check to realize the sound has no physical source.
Clamor.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (1 FX energy point)
Clamor.name: Clamor

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the sound can achieve deafening volumes, forcing anyone within a 2-meter radius to make a physical resolve check or be dazed for 1 round.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the max radius of the sound's positioning extends to 60 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the illusionist can introduce high-frequency distortion, causing targets within 3 meters of the focal point to suffer a +1 step penalty to listening checks.

Clamor.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 29

Cloak of the phoenix.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: The pyromancer envelopes themselves in a magnificent, winged aura of restorative and protective flames. While active, the cloak provides Ordinary toughness armor (d4) against physical attacks. More importantly, the phoenix flames grant the caster an accelerated mystical healing factor; the caster automatically recovers 1 point of stun or wound damage per round for the duration of the spell. The cloak lasts for 1 minute (5 combat rounds) per degree of success.
Cloak of the phoenix.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Cloak of the phoenix.name: Cloak of the phoenix

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, if the pyromancer is reduced to 0 mortal points while the cloak is active, the spell instantly discharges, automatically stabilizing the caster and restoring 1d4 wound points in a brilliant flash of healing fire.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the cloak extends to 10 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the armor protection provided by the flames increases to Good toughness (d6).

Cloak of the phoenix.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Command.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This spell allows the diabolist to issue binding, absolute commands to an extra-dimensional creature. The spell requires a contested roll against the target's mental resolve score. If successful, the creature must execute the command to the best of its ability, provided the command does not directly cause its own immediate destruction.
Command.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Command.name: Command

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the command can force the entity to act directly against its primary nature or alignment.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the target suffers a +1 step penalty to resist any subsequent commands during the same scene.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the diabolist can command up to three minor extra-dimensional creatures simultaneously, provided they are of the same type.

Command.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 23

Conceal.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Also known as Concealment. The caster bends light and ambient frequencies around a single non-living object, a minor structure, or a person within 2 meters, rendering it functionally invisible to normal visual scrutiny. Anyone looking directly at the concealed target must pass an Awareness-perception check with a +2 step penalty to notice the subtle visual shimmering.
Conceal.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Conceal.name: Conceal

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the step penalty to an observer's tracking or perception check improves to +4.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the spell can mask the target's auditory emissions as well as their visual profile.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the visual distortion handles motion better, allowing a concealed person to move up to their walk rate without breaking the effect.

Conceal.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Confidence.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This miracle bolsters the inner conviction and self-assurance of the priest or a touched ally, reinforcing their psychological framework against external manipulation or fear. Full Text: By centering their thoughts on the absolute harmony of the universe, the priest instills unshakeable clarity and focus. The target gains a -2 step bonus to all mental resolve and interaction checks for the duration of the scene, rendering them highly resilient against intimidation, mesmerism, or direct psychic coercion.
Confidence.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Confidence.name: Confidence

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the target becomes entirely immune to standard fear-inducing effects and mundane interaction penalties for the duration of the scene.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the step bonus improves to -3.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the miracle can affect all allies within a 5-meter radius of the priest.

Confidence.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 51

Confuse.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The mesmerist disrupts the target's cognitive patterns, rendering them momentarily disoriented and unable to process complex information. The target can attempt to resist with a mental resolve check. A successful casting inflicts a +2 step penalty to all intellectual, mechanical, and combat skill checks the victim attempts for the duration of the scene.
Confuse.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Confuse.name: Confuse

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, achieving an Amazing success on the check completely dazes the target for the first 2 rounds of the effect.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the step penalty inflicted increases to +3.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the mesmerist can target up to three individuals simultaneously if they are standing within 3 meters of each other.

Confuse.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 31

Cure.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This specialty acts as the core restorative miracle of the monotheistic church. It channels divine layout design principles into damaged or corrupted biological targets. Full Text: This miracle allows the priest to cure physical conditions, biological poisons, diseases, or mental instabilities via deep prayer or direct laying on of hands. A successful check can neutralize toxic hazards or scale back severe internal infections.
Cure.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Cure.name: Cure

rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, higher ranks scale the effectiveness to purge engineered alien plagues or completely mend severe psychological defects.

Cure.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Daedalus improved.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: Drawing upon ancient alchemical blueprints and structural geometry, the hermetic magus temporarily alters the physical properties of a crafted object, such as a heavy cloak, an exoskeleton, or artificial wings. The spell grants the object functional aerodynamic properties that defy normal physics, allowing the wearer to fly at their normal run rate for 10 minutes.
Daedalus improved.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Daedalus improved.name: Daedalus improved

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell can be used to enchant a much larger object or even a non-aerodynamic vehicle weighing up to 500 kilograms, granting it the ability to hover and fly.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the flight speed increases to the character's sprint rate.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the duration of the aerodynamic enchantment extends to 1 hour.

Daedalus improved.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 27

Danger Sense.description: A Chi character with this ability is in tune with his surroundings to a greater extent than someone with the Danger Sense perk. The power is not cumulative with the perk. The character gets a -2 step bonus on all Awareness-intuition checks, +1 to his Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers, and any penalty for fighting blind is reduced by 1 step. This power lasts for 10 minutes per activation.
Danger Sense.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character gains an additional -1 step bonus to intuition checks and an additional +1 to Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers. Any penalty for fighting blind is reduced by an additional step (cannot grant a bonus).
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the character gains an additional -1 step bonus to intuition checks and an additional +1 to Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers. Any penalty for fighting blind is reduced by an additional step (cannot grant a bonus).

Danger Sense.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 63

Demon ward.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Malicious extra-dimensional entities must pass a physical resolve check to step over the threshold. Full Text: This miracle protects all within 5 meters of the monotheist from the presence of demons, diabolists, and hostile spirits. Such beings must make a physical resolve skill check to pass into the affected area.
Demon ward.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)
Demon ward.name: Demon ward

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the radius increases to 30 meters.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the radius of the warded area increases to 10 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the radius increases to 20 meters.

Demon ward.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Dirge of the null-mind.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: At the start of each round after the miracle is invoked, those within the 10-meter area of effect must make a Resolve-mental resolve skill check or suffer 1 point of fatigue damage and temporarily lose 1 point from Intelligence and Will. Targets whose Intelligence or Will drops to 0 fall unconscious until the miracle ends. This miracle causes a repetitive sound to begin. This sound instills lethargy and a sense of vapidity into all within 10 meters except the alienist. Fatigue damage must be recovered normally. The dirge lasts 1 round for every degree of success of the skill check.
Dirge of the null-mind.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Dirge of the null-mind.name: Dirge of the Null-Mind

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the duration increases by 1 round.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the duration increases by 1 round.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the duration increases by 1 round.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the duration increases by 1 round.

Dirge of the null-mind.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 38

Disrupt technology.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Any mechalus or similar being targeted by this miracle also suffers a +2 step penalty on all actions including action checks due to a temporary shutdown of interior nanites and electronic systems. Such beings cannot use their natural ability to link with computers. Full Text: This miracle causes one target within 30 meters of the priest that relies on electronic circuits (including most cybernetics) to stop functioning for the duration of the miracle. Examples of targets that may be affected include a computer, a control station for a ship, or a person with one or more cybernetic implants. The last case would render the implants nonfunctional but not otherwise affect the person. The miracle lasts 1 round plus 1 round for every degree of success of the skill check.
Disrupt technology.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Disrupt technology.name: Disrupt technology
Disrupt technology.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 44

Dominate.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This powerful spell allows the mesmerist to strip away a victim's free will and seize direct command of their nervous system and motor actions. This spell triggers an immediate contested roll against the target's mental resolve score. If successful, the victim must execute the caster's telepathic or spoken orders explicitly. Commands that directly force self-destruction grant the target an immediate secondary check with a -2 step bonus to break the spell.
Dominate.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Dominate.name: Dominate

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the dominance becomes an enduring mental anchor, lasting up to 24 hours or until explicitly dispelled by an external FX power.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of absolute mental dominance extends to 10 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the target no longer receives a defense bonus or secondary check when ordered to perform hazardous tasks.

Dominate.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 31

Dreamwalking.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The shaman can change the targeted location as often as every round without needing to invoke the miracle again. Full Text: The dreamwalking miracle gives the shaman the ability to send her consciousness outside her body and perceive distant events, seeing and hearing locations within 1 kilometer.
Dreamwalking.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Dreamwalking.name: Dreamwalking

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the range becomes 10 kilometers.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the shaman can communicate simple concepts to those she observes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range increases to 5 kilometers.

Dreamwalking.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 46

Embryonic breathing.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This breathing technique reverts the hero's breathing to a state like that within the womb. It generates curative effects and heals damage based on the result of the skill check. Full Text: By controlling their respiration to match primal baseline values, the user accelerates metabolic recovery and purifies their internal tissues. A successful check restores stun or wound damage based on the level of success achieved.
Embryonic breathing.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Embryonic breathing.name: Embryonic breathing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can survive completely without external oxygen intake for up to 1 hour while executing this technique.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the deep trance allows the recovery of 1 point of fatigue damage per hour of rest.

Embryonic breathing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 51

Emotion.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: The caster forces a wave of overwhelming emotion (such as absolute panic, blinding rage, or profound sorrow) into the mind of a single target within 10 meters. The target must pass a mental resolve check to resist the impulse. Blinding rage forces the target to attack the nearest creature regardless of alignment; panic forces an immediate tactical retreat; sorrow applies a +2 step penalty to all actions.
Emotion.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Emotion.name: Emotion

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the emotional shock is so severe that it deals d4 points of mental stun damage upon initial impact.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the emotional surge radiates outward, affecting all targets within a 3-meter radius of the focal point.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the duration extends from a few rounds to the duration of the entire scene.

Emotion.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 32

Encourage.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: The mesmerist transmits waves of pure confidence, bravery, and absolute resolve into the mind of an ally within 10 meters. The target immediately sheds any active step penalties derived from non-mortal wounds, intimidation, or fear-inducing effects, and gains a -1 step bonus to all action checks for the remainder of the scene.
Encourage.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Encourage.name: Encourage

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the targeted ally temporarily gains 2 bonus stun points that buffer against incoming damage for the duration of the combat.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the step bonus to action checks improves to -2.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the mesmerist can project this mental encouragement to all allies within a 5-meter radius.

Encourage.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 32

Energy Blast.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifier: The target's Dexterity resistance modifier applies to this skill check. This power allows the character to shoot blasts of energy from his hands, eyes, or mouth. The player of a hero with this broad skill should choose a single type of energy to be wielded from the energy types list (Cold, Electricity, Fire/heat/plasma, Gravity, Light, Radiation, Sound). The energy blast has a range of 60 meters. The hero can fire no more than one blast per phase, and each blast costs 1 FX energy point. A successful check indicates the damage inflicted: d4+1w/d6+1w/d4m (En/O). A character who selects this power as always active constantly emits beams of energy and cannot shut them off. Special equipment—such as an energy containment suit, a high-tech visor, or protective gloves—is necessary to keep the character from destroying everything around himself. Even with this option, the hero must make a normal energy blast skill check to attack, and Failure indicates a miss.
Energy Blast.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. Cost: 4 skill points. This skill can't be used untrained.
Energy Blast.name: Energy Blast

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the damage improves to Good intensity.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the damage increases to d6+1w/d6+2w/d4+1m.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the damage increases to d6+2w/d8+2w/d4+2m.

Energy Blast.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 64

Energy Control.description: This power allows the character to manipulate existing sources of a specific type of energy, shaping it, moving it, or extinguishing it without generating it themselves.
Energy Control.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Energy Control.name: Energy Control

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Volume: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the volume of energy the character can control increases exponentially.

Energy Field.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Reduces weapon or attack firepowers by one grade (Amazing to Good, Good to Ordinary, Ordinary to no damage). Weakening or opening the field to attack makes the protected individual vulnerable from that general direction. This power allows the hero to create a protective barrier that causes attacks to deflect away from anything sheltered by it. The energy field can fully protect either the user or another single person of weren size or smaller within 30 meters. Maintaining the field requires no actions, but switching it to another target takes an action. Each activation of the energy field lasts 1 minute (5 rounds).
Energy Field.meta: Active or 2 FX energy points. Cost: 4 skill points. This skill can't be used untrained.
Energy Field.name: Energy Field

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero's energy field reduces damage by two intensities (Amazing damage is reduced to Ordinary, and damage of Good intensity or less is ignored). However, this advanced field may only be created around the hero herself and cannot include any others.
rank_benefits.3: At ranks 3, 6, and 9, the character can make a larger energy field, allowing her to protect one additional person at each of these ranks.
rank_benefits.6: At ranks 3, 6, and 9, the character can make a larger energy field, allowing her to protect one additional person at each of these ranks.
rank_benefits.9: At ranks 3, 6, and 9, the character can make a larger energy field, allowing her to protect one additional person at each of these ranks.

Energy Field.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 65-66

Energy Resistance.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: Grants Ordinary toughness armor of d4+1 against the selected type of energy. Checked first before damage spills over to normal armor types. This power allows the character to resist one type of energy without harm. Damage resisted with this power does not cause secondary damage. Each use of this power lasts 1 minute per degree of success.
Energy Resistance.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Energy Resistance.name: Energy Resistance

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the toughness of the energy resistance becomes Good.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero's protection increases to d6+1 against the selected form of energy.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hero's protection increases to d8+1 against the selected form of energy.

Energy Resistance.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 66

Energy Sheath/Form.description: This power has two forms: Either the character can surround herself with a particular type of energy, or she can transform herself and all equipment carried into a mostly solid form of that energy.
Energy Sheath/Form.meta: Active or 1 or 3 FX energy points. This skill can't be used untrained.
Energy Sheath/Form.name: Energy Sheath/Form

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the armor toughness and damage category improve to Good.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the armor increases...
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the damage increases to d4 points of wound damage for energy sheath or d6 points of wound damage for energy form.

Energy drain.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This dark spell allows the necromancer to leech the vital life force directly from a living target within 5 meters. The victim must pass a physical resolve check to resist. On a failure, the target suffers fatigue or stun damage, and the necromancer immediately heals an equivalent amount of damage, effectively transferring the stolen vitality to their own durability tracker.
Energy drain.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Energy drain.name: Energy drain

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the necromancer can temporarily absorb a portion of the victim's maximum FX energy pool along with their physical durability.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the spell drains wound damage instead of stun damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the life siphon extends to 15 meters.

Energy drain.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 33

Energy spiral.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This creates an active outward projection of structured Chi to deflect kinetic or energy impacts. Full Text: The priest externalizes their inner life force into a spinning vortex or radiant sphere of protective Chi. This energetic barrier surrounds the priest or a chosen target within 10 meters, actively neutralizing or deflecting incoming vectors. The energy spiral absorbs damage up to a specific intensity, acting as an exceptional buffer against LI, HI, or En attacks.
Energy spiral.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (2 FX energy points)
Energy spiral.name: Energy spiral

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, any melee attacker who hits the barrier triggers a structural backlash, sustaining d4 points of stun damage (En/O).
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the defensive barrier adds a +1 step penalty to all incoming ranged attacks targeted at the protected individual.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the energy spiral can be expanded to protect up to three contiguous targets standing within 3 meters of each other.

Energy spiral.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 52

Erzuli's fetish.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Erzuli is the Loa of love, beauty, and human passion. Imprinting her spiritual frequency onto a handheld item or piece of jewelry creates a functional fetish that dramatically enhances the bearer's charisma and charm. The individual holding or wearing the fetish gains a -2 step bonus to all Interaction-charm and Interaction-seduction checks.
Erzuli's fetish.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)
Erzuli's fetish.name: Erzuli's fetish

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the fetish directly grants a temporary +1 point to the bearer's base Personality score while held.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the fetish remains charged and active for up to 12 hours before naturally dissipating.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the -2 step bonus expands to encompass all Interaction-based specialty skills.

Erzuli's fetish.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 54

Everyman.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This subtle but highly effective illusion shifts the target's perception of the caster, making them appear completely unremarkable and forgettable. While active, the caster simply blends into any crowd or environment as long as they do not take overt or aggressive actions. Anyone attempting to remember the caster's face or specific identifying details later suffers a +2 step penalty to their Intelligence or Awareness skill checks. The illusion lasts for the duration of the scene or until the caster initiates combat.
Everyman.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Everyman.name: Everyman

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell actively deflects mechanical surveillance; cameras and recording devices capture only a blurred, generic humanoid shape.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the memory-clouding effect is stronger; observers suffer a +3 step penalty to recall the caster.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the illusion holds even if the caster speaks or interacts briefly with others (such as ordering a drink or asking for directions).

Everyman.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Exorcism.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This is handled as an extended complex check where target entities use their mental resolve to resist. Full Text: This miracle involves a long, complex process that can banish demons and evil spirits from the physical world or otherwise rid a host of a possessing foreign presence.
Exorcism.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Exorcism.name: Exorcism

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, this improves to a -3 step bonus.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero receives a -1 step bonus to exorcism skill checks.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, this improves to a -2 step bonus.

Exorcism.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Extra limb.description: The user has an extra FX-powered manipulative limb, such as prehensile hair or a telekinetic hand. If chosen as active, this skill can represent an extra arm or a prehensile tail. The hero can command the extra limb to perform any action her hands could do. It is considered to be an off hand and thus suffers a +2 step penalty to any action. Using the extra limb simultaneously with one of the hero's normal limbs inflicts the penalties listed under the Two Actions at Once section in Chapter 3: Heroes in Action in the Player's Handbook. If the hero uses the extra limb at the same time she uses both of her hands, the third action receives a +6 step penalty. The Ambidextrous perk reduces any penalty for using multiple limbs to 0/+2 (or 0/+2/+4 for three limbs) regardless of the nature of the limbs. Each activation of the extra limb lasts for 10 minutes.
Extra limb.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Extra limb.name: Extra limb

rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, improved Control: At ranks 3, 6, 9, and 12, the penalty for using the FX limb is reduced by one step.

Extra limb.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 58

Eyes of the dark ones.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Lasts 10 minutes per degree of success of the skill check. Reveals all hidden elements within 30 meters. This miracle lets the alienist see things that are concealed by arcane or technological means. Any sort of device or FX that hides something from sight through mental deception, warping light rays, or any other means is useless against this miracle, which reveals all such objects within 30 meters of the alienist and limns them with a sickly greenish glow in his sight. Occasionally even inhabitants and scenery of nearby dimensions are revealed in a limited fashion in locations where the barriers between dimensions are thin.
Eyes of the dark ones.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Augur miracle (1 FX energy point)
Eyes of the dark ones.name: Eyes of the Dark Ones
Eyes of the dark ones.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 39

Fiery bolt.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The caster conjures a condensed, highly volatile projectile of searing magical flame and hurls it at a single target within 30 meters. The bolt requires a successful skill check against the target's resistance modifier to hit. A successful strike inflicts d4w/d6w/d8w (En/O) damage. Any highly flammable materials (like dry wood, cloth, or fuel) struck by the bolt are instantly ignited.
Fiery bolt.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (1 FX energy point)
Fiery bolt.name: Fiery bolt

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the extreme heat of the projectile allows it to bypass standard thermal shielding, entirely ignoring armor that only provides Ordinary protection against Energy (En) attacks.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the maximum range of the fiery bolt extends to 60 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the pyromancer can overcharge the spell, spending 1 additional FX energy point to increase the damage profile to d4+1w/d6+1w/d8+1w.

Fiery bolt.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Fire wall.description: This spell creates a wall of flames with an area of up to 20 square meters (for instance, 2 meters tall and 10 meters long).
Fire wall.name: Fire wall

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Area: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the area of the fiery wall increases by 10 square meters.

Flame gauntlet.description: This spell creates a nimbus of flame around one of the caster's hands and any weapon in that hand. The caster can then use this flame to inflict additional damage.
Flame gauntlet.name: Flame gauntlet

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Damage: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the damage inflicted by the flame gauntlet increases by 1 point in each category.

Flying.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Normal penalties for taking actions while gliding or flying apply per TABLE P11: COMBAT MOVEMENT EFFECTS in the Player's Handbook. Hovering takes no concentration and inflicts no penalty to actions. Opting for permanent active wings drops the always-active pool reduction cost from 3 to 2 points. This power allows the character to fly or glide at the appropriate combat movement rate. This power uses 1 FX point per 10 minutes of use. If this power is chosen as always active, the hero has the option of having physical wings to provide flight. These wings can resemble those of birds, bats, insects, or something more exotic. A winged character cannot hover. Characters with this power should consider learning the Acrobatics-flight specialty skill, since this power itself grants no particular maneuverability.
Flying.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Flying.name: Flying

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's fly and glide rates increase to four times the base rates.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's fly and glide rates increase to two times the base rates.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's fly and glide rates increase to three times the base rates.

Flying.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68

Focus.description: Much like the Stamina-resist pain skill, the focus Chi power allows the user to push beyond physical and mental pain and trauma to act as if those things simply didn't exist for a time. When this power is activated, all penalties from a dazed state, torture, mortal damage, fatigue damage, poison, and disease are ignored for the purpose of determining what step penalties the Chi user must take when performing an action. Total loss of stun, wound, mortal, or fatigue points has the normal effect on the hero. A hero could be suffering from 3 points of mortal damage, 2 points of fatigue, a terminal illness, and a paralytic poison, and she could still perform all normal actions without penalty. Situational penalties not related to the character's physical or mental state, such as performing surgery on an alien or hacking into a bank computer, still apply. This power lasts 4 phases. At the end of that time it can be automatically extended for 1 FX energy point.
Focus.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Focus.name: Focus

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the focus lasts 5 rounds. It lasts 5 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, 30 minutes.

Focus.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 63

Forgetfulness.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The mesmerist wipes a specific short-term memory or a block of recent time from the target's consciousness. The target must pass a mental resolve check to resist the psychic intrusion. A successful casting erases up to the last 5 minutes of the victim's immediate memory, replacing the gap with a hazy, indistinct blur. The victim will not remember encountering the caster or the events that just transpired.
Forgetfulness.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Forgetfulness.name: Forgetfulness

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell can erase up to an entire week of memories. The erasure is permanent unless actively restored by an Amazing success using a psychic or FX restorative power.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the mesmerist can erase up to 1 hour of recent memory.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the memory wipe extends to a full 24-hour period, or it can be used to surgically remove a specific memory of a single event or person from the target's past.

Forgetfulness.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 32

Fortitude.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: The necromancer floods their own body with a surge of dark, animating negative energy to artificially enhance their physical resilience. While under the effects of this spell, the caster ignores the standard step penalties associated with being wounded or fatigued. They also gain a -1 step bonus to all Stamina-resist pain checks and Constitution feat checks to resist toxic or biological hazards.
Fortitude.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Fortitude.name: Fortitude

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the necromancer becomes completely immune to stun point loss and fatigue accumulation for the duration of the spell.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the unnatural fortitude extends to 1 hour.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the spell provides the caster with 2 temporary wound points that absorb incoming physical damage before depleting their actual durability tracker.

Fortitude.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Fusillade.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Modifiers: Activating this power does not take an action. Attempting to use this power in a phase earlier than the hero's action check result applies a +1 step penalty to the fusillade skill check. This power can only be attempted once per round whether successful or not. Takes 1 point of fatigue damage after combat for every extra action taken. This power gives the character the ability to attack more often during combat. During combat, the player rolls an action check as normal. However, the hero can make one extra attack during any phase by spending 1 FX energy point and making a successful fusillade skill check. For example, a hero with an Ordinary action check result can try to activate this power in the Amazing or Good phase at a +1 step penalty to attack early, or make an extra attack in either the Ordinary or Marginal phase after taking his normal action.
Fusillade.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / 1 FX energy point
Fusillade.name: Fusillade

rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character can use this power up to two times per round, although only one extra action can be taken in any given phase.

Fusillade.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68

Genius.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: When active, grants the hero a -2 step bonus to Knowledge-deduce skill checks as well as any Knowledge skill checks made to determine specific campaign information. This power greatly enhances a hero's powers of deduction, reasoning, analysis, and memory. This power lasts for 1 hour.
Genius.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Genius.name: Genius

rank_benefits.10: At rank 10, the analysis step bonus increases to -2.
rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can select a third broad skill and receive the same bonus.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero can select an Intelligence-based broad skill. While genius is active, the hero receives a -1 step bonus to all skill checks made using that broad skill or its specialty skills.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, a hero who studies a situation (such as a battle, a puzzle, a secured building, and so forth) for at least 5 rounds (1 minute) gains a -1 step bonus on action checks or complex skill checks made in relation to that situation. This benefit lasts throughout the current situation. For instance, if a battle were studied, the effect would last until the battle ended.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hero can select a second broad skill and gain a similar bonus.

Genius.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 66

Ghost dance.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The shaman or one person chosen by the shaman is granted an additional +3 to his resistance modifier against all melee and ranged attacks by this miracle. Full Text: The ghost dance summons guardian spirits to protect the shaman and tribe.
Ghost dance.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Summon miracle (2 FX energy points)
Ghost dance.name: Ghost dance

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the number of dancers increases to 250.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the shaman can affect up to fifty dancers.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the duration increases to 4 hours.

Ghost dance.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 46-47

Gibbering larvae.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Jaws inflict d4s/d4+1s/d4w (LI/O) and lock onto their target with a successful hit, automatically inflicting 1s/2s/1w every phase thereafter. The larvae possess a +3 resistance modifier vs. mental attacks and an always active form of eyes of the dark ones. This miracle summons one or more sluglike alien creatures that appear at the alienist's feet and attack targets indicated by the alienist. The larvae have Ability Scores and skill scores equivalent to the scorpion in the Animal Compendium. This damage only ends with the death of the larvae or the end of the miracle's duration. The gibbering larvae remain for 5 rounds. One larva responds to the summons for every degree of success of the gibbering larvae skill check.
Gibbering larvae.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Summon miracle (1 FX energy point)
Gibbering larvae.name: Gibbering Larvae

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, an additional larva is summoned.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the larvae remain for an additional round.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, an additional larva is summoned.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the larvae remain for an additional round.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, an additional larva is summoned.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the larvae remain for an additional round.

Gibbering larvae.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 38-39

Glamour.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Through the application of subtle alchemical reagents and mystical geometry, the hermetic magus alters their outward physical appearance, vocal cords, and pheromonal output. Unlike the holographic tricks of the Illusion school, this is a minor physical transmutation of the skin and scent. The caster gains a -2 step bonus to Interaction checks and can mimic the general appearance and voice of a specific humanoid target of the same size. The transformation lasts for 1 hour.
Glamour.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Glamour.name: Glamour

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the structural shift is so complete that the step bonus to Interaction checks improves to -3, and the caster can mimic targets of a slightly larger or smaller size category.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the glamour increases to 4 hours.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the physical mimicry is flawless enough to bypass basic biometric security scanners (such as retinal, voice, or fingerprint scanners) with an Ordinary skill check.

Glamour.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 28

Gris-gris.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: A gris-gris is a small, specialized charm bag combining token materials to manifest a targeted intent. It can be deployed in two configurations determined at the time of creation: a protective configurations that shields an ally, or a hostile configuration that serves as a hex against an enemy. If protective, it grants a +1 bonus to all resistance modifiers against incoming hostile FX or psionic manipulation. If configured as a hex, the intended target must pass a mental resolve check or suffer a +1 step penalty to all action checks for the duration of the scene.
Gris-gris.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Gris-gris.name: Gris-gris

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the structural charge of the gris-gris handles exposure well, remaining completely active for up to 24 hours.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, a protective configurations bag grants an increased +2 bonus to all core resistance modifiers.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, a hostile hex configuration bag increases its penalty, adding a +2 step penalty to the victim's action checks.

Gris-gris.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 54

Growing.description: This power allows the hero and all gear he wears or carries to grow in height and mass. The character's height and mass increase by 50%. The character's Strength is considered 2 points higher for purposes of melee damage, lifting capacity, and breaking objects. As a larger target, the hero also suffers a +1 step penalty to his defense against all attacks. Gear that grows with the character functions normally (a blaster pistol still does its normal damage, armor still provides its normal protection). Active growth lasts 10 minutes.
Growing.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Growing.name: Growing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can grow to 250% of normal height, increasing his Strength by 6 points and penalizing his defense by +3 steps.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, a hero can grow to 200% of normal height, increasing his Strength by 4 points and penalizing his defense by +2 steps.

Growing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Guidance.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Delivers conceptual feedback (feelings of right or wrong) to direct party exploration. Full Text: With this miracle, the priest prays for advice on a particular problem or course of action currently facing the heroes. The priest is answered with a feeling or sense of rightness or wrongness about the possible actions.
Guidance.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Augur miracle (1 FX energy point)
Guidance.name: Guidance

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, higher ranks clarify the abstract sensation into short auditory cues or literal layout direction markers.

Guidance.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Guide my hand.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This miracle calls upon an appropriate helpful spirit to lend the shaman its skill in combat. The shaman gains a -2 step bonus to her choice of certain combat skills.
Guide my hand.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Guide my hand.name: Guide my hand
Guide my hand.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 47

Haunt.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This spell summons a minor ghost to frighten, harass, and annoy a target if it is bound to a person, or it hounds people within 10 meters of its target if bound to a location or object. The haunting spirit drops ambient temperatures, creates unsettling noises, and forces anyone in the area to make a mental resolve check or suffer a +1 step penalty to all actions due to fear and distraction.
Haunt.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Summon spell (2 FX energy points)
Haunt.name: Haunt

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the haunt becomes permanent until dispelled by an exorcism or similar FX power.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the haunt extends to 24 hours.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the ghost can physically manifest to deliver a chilling touch, inflicting d4 stun damage once per scene to a random target in the area.

Haunt.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 33
