Healing.description: This power allows the user to heal damage to himself. A successful skill check heals 2, 3, or 4 wounds. The healing power can only be used once per hour. It costs 1 fatigue point with each use.
Healing.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Healing.name: Healing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, healing Trance: At rank 12, the hero can, with a successful healing skill check, enter a sleeplike trance during which mortal damage is healed at a rate of 1 mortal point per 4 hours. This does not cause fatigue damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, improved Healing: At rank 4, the amount healed improves to 3/4/5 points. At rank 8, it improves to 4/5/6 points.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, improved Healing: At rank 4, the amount healed improves to 3/4/5 points. At rank 8, it improves to 4/5/6 points.

Healing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 63

Heart of the Cosimir.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The priest must touch his intended target for the miracle to have any effect. Full Text: This miracle gives the targeted creature clarity of thought and spirit. For the duration of the miracle, the target has a -3 step bonus to all actions, but it cannot use any technological device of Progress Level 4 or greater, or the miracle ends immediately. The duration is 1 round plus 1 round per level of success of the skill check.
Heart of the Cosimir.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Heart of the Cosimir.name: Heart of the Cosimir
Heart of the Cosimir.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 44

Hellfire.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The diabolist summons a burst of dark, corrupting flames directly from an infernal dimension. Unlike normal pyromancy, hellfire burns both the physical body and the life force of the target, bypassing standard thermal resistance, fireproofing gear, and environmental immunities. The caster targets a single opponent within 20 meters, inflicting d4w/d6w/d8w (En/O) damage upon a successful strike.
Hellfire.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (2 FX energy points)
Hellfire.name: Hellfire

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the corrupting nature of the flames is so intense that targets damaged by the spell cannot be healed by natural biological recovery or standard FX healing powers for 24 hours.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the damage of the infernal flames improves to d4+1w/d6+1w/d8+1w.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hellfire can be cast as an area-of-effect blast, targeting everyone within a 3-meter radius of the focal point.

Hellfire.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 16

Helpful possession.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The priest willingly lowers their mental barriers to allow a benign, lesser Loa to inhabit their physical shell. While actively possessed, the priest's mind is locked in a state of unshakeable focus, entirely ignoring any current step penalties derived from stun damage accumulation, dazed states, or superficial wounds. Furthermore, the guiding spirit sharpens physical coordination, granting a flat -1 step bonus to all physical actions and combat maneuvers.
Helpful possession.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Helpful possession.name: Helpful possession

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the presence of the Loa overclocks the nervous system, granting a temporary +1 point to the priest's base Dexterity score while possessed.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the safe spiritual possession extends to 10 minutes per invocation.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the spirit's physical coordination bonus improves, granting a -2 step bonus to physical actions.

Helpful possession.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 55

Homunculus.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This spell enables the alchemist to fashion and animate a tiny, artificial construct assistant out of clay, blood, and rare chemicals. The homunculus acts as a direct extension of the caster's senses and will, obeying simple layout commands implicitly. It possesses minor physical attributes equivalent to a tiny animal companion (minimal combat thresholds, exceptional stealth profile). The creation ritual takes 1 hour to perform and requires a dedicated workshop space.
Homunculus.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Summon spell (2 FX energy points)
Homunculus.name: Homunculus

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the homunculus gains rudimentary speech and an independent Intelligence score of 7.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the homunculus can travel up to 1 kilometer away from the caster while maintaining a fluid sensory link.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the construct can act as a delivery vector, channeling a single minor touch-based spell cast by the master.

Homunculus.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 27

Hunger.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: This spell allows the caster to draw nourishment and energy directly from the freshly spilled blood of a living target within 2 meters. A successful check heals the hemomancer of 2 points of stun or fatigue damage per degree of success, while the victim suffers an equivalent amount of fatigue.
Hunger.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Hunger.name: Hunger

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, an Amazing success allows the caster to temporarily steal 1 point of the target's base Strength or Constitution score for d4 rounds.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the spell can heal wound damage (1 wound point per Good success).
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the spell can be cast on a target up to 5 meters away as an active crimson siphon.

Hunger.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 26

Hunter's stare.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: On an Ordinary success, the target loses its next action due to sudden paralysis from predatory fear. Full Text: This miracle allows the shaman to momentarily assume the mental state of a predator and paralyze a target with fear.
Hunter's stare.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Hunter's stare.name: Hunter's stare
Hunter's stare.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 47

Hyper Learning.description: Allows the hero to assimilate new knowledge rapidly and use it as if skilled. To use it, the hero must witness or otherwise learn about the skill for at least 5 rounds (1 minute). Studying 3 minutes gives a -1 step bonus; 10 minutes gives -2; 30 minutes gives -3. On success, the hero gains one free broad skill or two ranks in one specialty skill, but no skill rank can exceed 12. Mundane skills only; it cannot learn or improve mindwalking or FX skills, and it cannot make the hero remember the skill beyond the duration. The benefit lasts 1 hour per degree of success and is not cumulative with itself.
Hyper Learning.meta: Manual: Hyper Learning; Super Power FX - Metaconscious; Specialty cost 4; Ability INT; 1 FX energy point; cannot be used untrained; Beyond Science pp. 66-67.
Hyper Learning.name: Hyper Learning

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, gains two more additional ranks.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, increased Learning - gains two additional ranks in the chosen specialty skill.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, gains two more additional ranks.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, gains two more additional ranks.

Hypnotize.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: A mesmerist uses this spell to put a single individual within 2 meters into a highly receptive, compliant mood for suggestions or further mental influences. The target must be relatively calm or distracted to initialize the trance. While hypnotized, the target suffers a +3 step penalty to notice their surroundings or resist further Mesmerism interactions.
Hypnotize.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Hypnotize.name: Hypnotize

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the trance is so deep that the subject can be cleanly wiped of any memory of the hypnosis session or the preceding 10 minutes.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the mesmerist can affect up to five targets simultaneously if they are clustered together and listening to the caster's voice.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hypnotized subject can be implanted with a post-hypnotic suggestion triggered by a specific word or environmental cue up to 24 hours later.

Hypnotize.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 32

Immolation.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This spell wreaths the pyromancer's body in a swirling aura of magical fire that does not harm the caster or their equipment. Any creature striking the pyromancer with a bare-handed melee attack or natural weapon suffers d4 points of wound damage (En/O) from the intense heat. Additionally, the caster's own unarmed strikes inflict an additional d4 wound damage (En/O). The aura provides Ordinary toughness protection (d4) against cold or ice-based attacks.
Immolation.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Immolation.name: Immolation

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the caster can trigger the aura to flare violently once per scene, blinding anyone within a 3-meter radius who fails a Constitution feat check.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the damage dealt to attackers and added to unarmed strikes increases to d6 wound damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the immolation aura extends outward slightly, automatically melting incoming low-velocity projectiles like arrows or thrown knives, granting a +1 step penalty to incoming ranged attacks.

Immolation.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 35

Impact Conversion.description: This unusual power gives the character the ability to absorb kinetic energy and transform it into enhanced physical power. Whenever the hero is struck by an attack that delivers LI- or HI-type damage, roll d4 and subtract the result from the base damage inflicted regardless of the firepower of the attack. If the attack inflicts mortal damage, subtract 2 from this die roll for the purposes of damage reduction (to a minimum of 1 point), but retain the full value for the power's secondary effect (listed below). Apply the reduced damage total as normal, including calculating armor protection and any secondary damage inflicted. This energy is immediately converted into physical might. The hero can add the number rolled to the damage inflicted by her next melee attack. This attack expends the extra energy whether successful or not. Multiple absorptions are cumulative; however, any points remaining at the end of the 5-round duration are lost. If the power is selected as always active, no absorbed energy remains for longer than 5 rounds.
Impact Conversion.meta: Active or 2 FX energy points. This skill can't be used untrained.
Impact Conversion.name: Impact Conversion

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero absorbs and converts 1 additional point of LI or HI damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero absorbs and converts 1 additional point of LI or HI damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hero absorbs and converts 1 additional point of LI or HI damage.

Impact Conversion.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 61

Incendiary seal.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The pyromancer traces a glowing, occult rune on a solid surface (such as a door, floor, or chest), creating a highly volatile magical trap. The seal becomes invisible to normal sight 1 round after casting. If a creature other than the caster touches or passes within 1 meter of the sealed object, the rune detonates in a fiery explosion. The blast inflicts d6w/d8w/d4m (En/O) damage to everyone within a 3-meter radius.
Incendiary seal.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (2 FX energy points)
Incendiary seal.name: Incendiary seal

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the damage profile of the explosion increases to d8w/d4m/d6m (En/G).
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the blast radius of the incendiary seal expands to 5 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the caster can set specific bypass conditions for the trap, such as a spoken password or allowing specific individuals to pass safely.

Incendiary seal.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 35

Interior alchemy.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This miracle provides profound systemic regulation, restructuring internal chemistry to combat toxic agents or biological infections. Full Text: By actively manipulating the primary channels of internal energy, the priest can purify their blood or alter their fundamental biological reactions. This inner transmutation neutralizes toxic payloads, breaks down venom vectors, and drives out biological infections, instantly stabilizing an endangered character's health profile.
Interior alchemy.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Interior alchemy.name: Interior alchemy

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the miracle permanently reinforces the character's internal biology, granting a permanent +1 bonus to all future Constitution feat checks against toxicity.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the check gains a -1 step bonus when used to counter standard non-synthetic poisons.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the priest can safely filter and neutralize engineered or complex biological toxins.

Interior alchemy.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 52

Invisibility.description: This power allows the hero to become invisible to all sorts of visual detection including infrared, radar, and other sorts of electromagnetic-based scanning. Anyone attempting to locate the hero using one of these senses or by using an Awareness-perception or investigate check suffers a +4 step penalty to do so. Attacking an invisible character is usually done as a wild swing. The invisible character gains a -3 step bonus to stealth skill checks. The hero's clothing and gear become invisible along with him, provided that they are touching him when he becomes invisible. Items picked up do not become invisible, and things dropped become visible immediately. The power lasts 10 minutes.
Invisibility.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Invisibility.name: Invisibility

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, it becomes 40 minutes.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the power's duration becomes 20 minutes per degree of success.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, it becomes 30 minutes.

Invisibility.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Invulnerability.description: This power gives a hero invulnerability to one unusual attack form. The player should select the attack form at the time this skill is purchased. Examples include cold, corrosion (both acids and bases), electricity, fire and other heat-based attacks, poison, and radiation. The hero ignores all stun and wound damage dealt by such attacks and treats mortal damage as stun damage. Each use of this power lasts 10 minutes.
Invulnerability.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Invulnerability.name: Invulnerability

rank_benefits.5: At rank 5, the character can select an additional invulnerability.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the character can select an additional invulnerability.

Invulnerability.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 61-62

Kinship of beasts.description: This miracle allows the druid to form a powerful empathic bond with an animal to sense and influence emotions, communicate, or summon them.
Kinship of beasts.name: Kinship of beasts

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the druid can summon a single animal of any size.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the druid can summon twice as many animals as listed...
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, four times as many...

Knit wounds.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The necromancer channels negative energy to rapidly stitch together damaged tissue. Unlike the holy curing of Monotheism or the biological acceleration of Hemomancy, this healing is crude, painful, and leaves terrible scarring. A successful check heals 2 points of wound or stun damage, but the target must pass a Stamina-resist pain check or lose their next action due to the agonizing process.
Knit wounds.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Knit wounds.name: Knit wounds

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell can heal 1 point of mortal damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the spell heals 4 points of wound or stun damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the necromancer can use this spell to reattach a severed limb if the operation is performed within 10 minutes of the injury.

Knit wounds.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Legba rides.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Papa Legba acts as the gatekeeper of the spiritual crossroads, paths, and cosmic languages. Aligning with his energy grants the priest the immediate ability to read, speak, and intuitively comprehend any mortal or alien tongue encountered. Additionally, the miracle grants enhanced spatial awareness, mapping out hidden entryways, traps, or structural vulnerabilities within a 10-meter radius.
Legba rides.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Augur miracle (1 FX energy point)
Legba rides.name: Legba rides

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, Legba's crossroads translation effect radiates outward, allowing all allies within hearing distance to understand the alien dialogue.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the linguistic and spatial tracking duration extends to 30 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the radius for discovering hidden structures, traps, and paths increases to 30 meters.

Legba rides.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 55

Life Support.description: This power allows the character to survive without food, water, sleep, or even air without difficulty. Of course, certain abilities may not function in cases of extreme deprivation. For example, a character who can function without air can survive in space, but she cannot speak in that airless environment. The power sustains the character for up to 24 hours. After using this power, the character must let it rest for an equal amount of time before it can be used again.
Life Support.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Life Support.name: Life Support

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, it increases to 27 days.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of life support increases to 72 hours (3 days).
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, it increases to 9 days.

Life Support.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 62

Life endures.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: Target Bonuses/Penalties: Targeting natural flora or fauna grants a -2 step bonus to the roll. Targeting heroes with cybernetics or artificial implants inflicts a +2 step penalty (does not apply to a mechalus's free gear). Cooldown Constraint: Cannot be invoked on the same recipient twice within a 4-hour window. Full Text: This miracle allows a druid to heal damage to and cure diseases in himself or others via direct touch. Physical restoration scales by success: Ordinary heals 1 wound; Good heals 2; Amazing heals 3. Curing illness reduces disease states by one, two, or three grades respectively.
Life endures.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Life endures.name: Life endures

rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the druid can heal mortal damage. Check outcomes change to: Ordinary = 2 wounds; Good = 3 wounds or 1 mortal; Amazing = 4 wounds or 2 mortals.

Life endures.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 41

Life siphon.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Initial target proximity must be within 2 meters. Armor provides no protection against this miracle. Target sustains d4s/d6s/d8s (En/O) and the alienist is healed of that amount minus 1 point (excess points are lost). This miracle establishes a connection between the life force of a target within 2 meters and the alienist, then shifts the balance of the energy in favor of the alienist, healing them at the target's expense.
Life siphon.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Life siphon.name: Life Siphon

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the maximum distance of the target increases to 60 meters.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the maximum distance of the target increases to 10 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum distance of the target increases to 30 meters.

Life siphon.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 39

Lifeblood.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: The hemomancer safely accelerates their internal healing mechanics, using their own bloodstream to flush out impurities and close wounds. A successful check allows the caster to instantly convert up to 3 points of wound damage into stun damage, which can then be recovered much faster through conventional rest.
Lifeblood.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Lifeblood.name: Lifeblood

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spell can be cast via touch to mend the wounds of an ally.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hemomancer can use this spell to purge basic non-synthetic poisons or biological diseases from their system.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the conversion threshold improves, allowing up to 6 points of wound damage to be shifted to stun damage.

Lifeblood.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 26

Ligature.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This spell creates an invisible, unbreakable mystical bond or connection between two discrete objects or individuals. For the duration of the spell, what happens to one target physically or energetically echoes directly into the other. Alternatively, they can be mystically tethered together so that they cannot move more than a specified distance apart. An unwilling living target can resist this connection with a mental resolve check.
Ligature.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Ligature.name: Ligature

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the ligature can bind a physical object to a spiritual or phased entity, grounding it into the material realm.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the distance threshold between the tethered targets can be fixed up to 50 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, any kinetic impact or physical force exerted on one object is fully transferred to the other, allowing remote structural manipulation.

Ligature.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 28

Lightning Speed.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Modifiers: Costs 1 FX point per 10 minutes of use. Instantly doubles sprint, run, and walk rates upon purchase. This power allows the hero to greatly increase her running speed. Purchasing this skill immediately doubles the character's sprint, run, and walk movement rates.
Lightning Speed.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Lightning Speed.name: Lightning Speed

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the hero can run across liquid or other nonsolid surfaces, including snow, quicksand, or water. She moves as far as her adjusted run rate in meters before starting to sink.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the hero's sprint, run, and walk rates increase to three times the base rates.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the hero's sprint, run, and walk rates increase to four times the base rates.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the hero's sprint, run, and walk rates increase to five times the base rates.

Lightning Speed.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68

Loa of healing.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This specialty acts as the primary therapeutic avenue of the faith, calling upon restorative entities to mend broken flesh. Direct skin-to-skin touch is mandatory to channel the effect. Restoration scales explicitly by success: an Ordinary success heals 2 stun or 1 wound point; a Good success heals 4 stun or 2 wounds; an Amazing success heals 6 stun, 3 wounds, or 1 mortal point.
Loa of healing.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Loa of healing.name: Loa of healing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spiritual cleansing completely neutralizes aggressive systemic toxins, biological venom, or heavy internal infections alongside its standard physical mending.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the core restorative capacity of the miracle is increased across all brackets by 50% (rounded down).

Loa of healing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 55

Mighty Leap.description: With this power, the Chi user can make tremendous leaps. By spending 1 FX energy point, the character can leap twice as far as the values listed under the Athletics-jump skill. The hero also suffers minimum damage (1 point of stun damage) from a Marginal success and only d4 points of stun damage from a Critical Failure.
Mighty Leap.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Mighty Leap.name: Mighty Leap

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the multiplier for the character's jumping distance increases to five times normal.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the multiplier for the character's jumping distance increases to three times normal.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the multiplier for the character's jumping distance increases to four times normal.

Mighty Leap.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 63-64

Mindshatter.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The caster launches a devastating, unstructured wave of pure psychic trauma directly into the target's consciousness within 20 meters. This attack bypasses standard physical armor entirely. A successful strike deals mental damage scaling by success tier: Ordinary deals d4s; Good deals d6s; Amazing deals d4w points of direct damage to the target's durability tracking.
Mindshatter.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Mindshatter.name: Mindshatter

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, achieving an Amazing success leaves the target completely unconscious for d4 rounds following the mental trauma.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the psychic damage profile improves to d4+1s/d6+1s/d4+1w.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the psychic crushing vector extends to 40 meters.

Mindshatter.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 33

Moving pictures.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The illusionist designs a dynamic, moving three-dimensional visual illusion within a 3-meter radius space up to 30 meters away. The image follows a pre-programmed sequence or can be actively directed by the caster spending a phase of concentration. It produces no heat, sound, or physical impact, and passes through solid matter harmlessly.
Moving pictures.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (2 FX energy points)
Moving pictures.name: Moving pictures

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the inversion is so structurally flawless that observers must actively interact with or pass through it to trigger a perception check to disbelieve.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the illusion can be synchronized to include realistic, low-fidelity audio (requires combining with the Clamor specialty skill traits).
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum radius of the illusory display expands to 6 meters.

Moving pictures.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Mummy's curse.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The necromancer inflicts a terrible, wasting affliction upon a target within touch range. The victim must pass a physical resolve check. On a failure, the curse takes hold, halving their natural healing rate and preventing any FX or psionic healing from affecting them. The curse also inflicts 1 point of fatigue damage every 24 hours that cannot be recovered until the curse is lifted.
Mummy's curse.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Mummy's curse.name: Mummy's curse

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the fatigue damage increases to 1 point of wound damage every 24 hours.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the target suffers a permanent +1 step penalty to all Constitution-based checks while the curse is active.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the curse can be triggered at a range of 10 meters via a sympathetic link (such as a lock of the victim's hair).

Mummy's curse.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Negate the spirit.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This defensive miracle disrupts foreign spiritual interference, driving out malevolent possessions, energetic anchors, or active curses. When targeted at an entity actively possessing an ally, it triggers an immediate contested check against that entity's mental resolve score to banish it. If targeted directly at a hostile spellcaster or priest, an Amazing success temporarily jams their spiritual frequency, severing their connection to their FX energy pool for d4 rounds.
Negate the spirit.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Negate the spirit.name: Negate the spirit

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, achieving an Amazing success on the check permanently severs complex extra-dimensional curses, genetic hexes, or deep spiritual bindings.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, a successfully cleansed ally receives a +2 bonus to all resistance modifiers against subsequent possession or mental control attempts for 24 hours.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the banishment wave expands, operating as a 5-meter radius burst centered on the priest to disrupt multiple minor spectral entities.

Negate the spirit.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 56

Not doing.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Rooted in the philosophy of Wu Wei, this miracle allows the character to avoid harmful outcomes by blending seamlessly into the ambient flow of a situation rather than actively countering it. Full Text: The priest embraces complete stillness and non-resistance, allowing incoming kinetic forces or hostile social pressures to roll off them harmlessly. By matching the exact tempo and structure of their surroundings, the hero achieves a remarkable passive defense, adding substantial step penalties to an opponent's aggressive initiatives or complex tracking maneuvers.
Not doing.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Not doing.name: Not doing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character can phase their physical presence into absolute synchronization with the room, gaining a -2 step bonus to stealth checks even in plain sight.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the hero receives a -1 step bonus to defensive rolls while taking no active offensive actions.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, any active detection or tracking check directed at the hero suffers a +2 step penalty while they maintain this state.

Not doing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 52

Peace.description: This miracle projects a calming aura of tranquility that quells anger and violence in the immediate vicinity, bringing the area into closer alignment with the Tao.
Peace.name: Peace

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Area: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the radius of the peaceful aura expands.

Permeation.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This miracle alters physical interaction dynamics, allowing the priest to blend into solid structures. Full Text: Tapping into the atomic and energetic space between dense materials, the priest allows their physical form to naturally seep or slip into stone, earth, or wood. While permeating a structure, the priest is highly protected from standard physical combat vectors, though they must maintain strict breath control to avoid becoming trapped.
Permeation.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Permeation.name: Permeation

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the priest can seamlessly bring up to 10 kilograms of personal equipment or gear with them through the permeated barrier.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of structural permeation increases to 5 minutes.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the priest can move through basic solid materials at half their normal walk rate.

Permeation.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 53

Phasing.description: This FX allows the hero to shift his body's molecules out of phase with those of his environment, allowing him to pass through solid objects. While phased, the character ignores physical attacks, but energy-based attacks affect him normally. The character can only walk while phased and cannot pass through objects with a toughness greater than Poor. It takes one phase to pass through 1 meter of solid material. If the hero solidifies while inside a solid object, he takes d4+1 mortal damage and is pushed to the nearest open space. The duration of this power is 1 minute.
Phasing.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Phasing.name: Phasing

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, improved Phasing: At rank 12, the hero can move through any object of up to Amazing toughness. Increased Movement: At rank 12, the hero can sprint.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, increased Duration: At rank 3, duration increases to 5 minutes. At rank 9 this increases to 30 minutes.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, improved Phasing: At rank 6, the hero can move through objects of Good toughness. Increased Movement: At rank 6, the hero can run while phased.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, increased Duration: At rank 3, duration increases to 5 minutes. At rank 9 this increases to 30 minutes.

Phasing.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Power Climb.description: This power allows the user to climb up seemingly impossible surfaces or to move rapidly up surfaces that would normally require time to climb. If the surface is climbable by someone with the Athletics-climb skill without a penalty, then the character can simply run up the surface. She can reach a maximum height of twice her walk movement rate in meters before she must find a more horizontal surface upon which to rest or she falls. The character can also scale surfaces that have a step penalty to climb by climbing in a more normal manner. When doing this, she climbs at twice the rate listed under the climb skill. Each use of this power lasts 1 round.
Power Climb.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point per round. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Power Climb.name: Power Climb

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's multiplier for both running up walls and climbing increases to five times the listed values.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's multiplier for both running up walls and climbing increases to three times the listed values.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's multiplier for both running up walls and climbing increases to four times the listed values.

Power Climb.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 84 / 64

Power Strike.description: This ability allows the user to focus his will into one unarmed attack and to greatly increase its power and accuracy. The user gains a -1 step bonus on his next unarmed melee attack and inflicts 2 additional points of damage. The enhanced attack must be made within 5 rounds (1 minute) of the power strike skill check, or the effect fades.
Power Strike.meta: 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Power Strike.name: Power Strike

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, gains another -1 step bonus and a successful attack inflicts Amazing-quality damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Duration - the effect lasts up to 10 rounds or until used.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, increased Damage - gains another -1 step bonus on the next melee attack and successful attack inflicts Good-quality damage.

Power Strike.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 64

Power Swimming.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Modifiers: Allows the hero to swim at 150% of his normal swim or easy swim movement rate at no FX energy cost. Breathing water and surviving deep pressure does not translate into protection against incoming physical/energy attacks. Each activation lasts 10 minutes. This skill allows the hero to move faster in water or another liquid. The character can also breathe water and survive water pressure at depths as great as 500 meters.
Power Swimming.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Power Swimming.name: Power Swimming

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to eight times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to two times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to four times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the character's maximum depth and swim rate increase to six times the base values (requires active tracking of the super power to function).

Power Swimming.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 68-69

Programmed response.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This advanced illusion establishes a complex, localized holographic scenario within a 5-meter radius that reacts dynamically to specific triggers. The illusionist can script an event—such as an illusory guard demanding a password, or a fake wall crumbling to reveal a trap—that activates when an intruder enters the space. The programmed illusion persists passively for up to 24 hours before naturally dissipating if untriggered.
Programmed response.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (2 FX energy points)
Programmed response.name: Programmed response

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the programmed response can incorporate a minor physical element by triggering a secondary, pre-cast physical trap alongside the sensory illusion.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the illusion can be tied to a specific auditory trigger or time delay.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum passive duration of the untriggered illusion extends to one full week.

Programmed response.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Reciprocating.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: The hemomancer curses a hostile target within 10 meters, creating a violent biological feedback loop between their circulatory systems. The target can attempt to resist with a physical resolve check. If the spell takes hold, for the duration of the scene, any physical wound or mortal damage the hemomancer sustains from an external attack forces the cursed target to immediately suffer a reciprocating physiological shock, taking an equal amount of stun damage.
Reciprocating.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Reciprocating.name: Reciprocating

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the feedback loop amplifies the trauma; the target suffers the exact amount and type of damage (including mortal damage) that the hemomancer takes.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the reciprocating shock inflicts wound damage instead of stun damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the initial curse increases to 20 meters, and the reciprocating damage bypasses standard non-FX armor completely.

Reciprocating.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 20

Rend the weave.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The diabolist tears at the local dimensional fabric, creating a localized instability that disrupts active FX, psionics, or technological shielding. This spell triggers an immediate area-of-effect disruption within a 5-meter radius, adding a +2 step penalty to any active skill checks or operations involving energetic fields, spatial transitions, or dimensional anchors.
Rend the weave.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Rend the weave.name: Rend the weave

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the tear creates a brief spatial vacuum, forcing any phased or teleporting entities within the area to immediately materialize and sustain d4 points of stun damage.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the radius of the dimensional disruption expands to 10 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the disruption actively damages incoming energy fields, lowering their effectiveness by one intensity grade.

Rend the weave.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 23

Reward of toil.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The recipient of the miracle must be touched by the priest. Full Text: This miracle makes it easier to perform tasks that take extensive time or effort, such as working in a farmer's field or traveling overland by foot. The recipient of the miracle enjoys a -1 step bonus on all actions of this type and to any Movement specialty skill checks. She also suffers no fatigue damage for any such efforts made while the miracle is in effect. The miracle lasts 2 hours plus 2 hours for every degree of success of the skill check.
Reward of toil.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Reward of toil.name: Reward of toil
Reward of toil.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 44

Righteous wrath.description: This miracle fills the priest with divine fury against those who rely on corrupting technology. It grants the priest bonuses to combat skills when fighting opponents wielding high-tech weaponry (PL 4 or higher).
Righteous wrath.name: Righteous wrath

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, increased Damage: At ranks 4 and 8, the priest inflicts additional damage against technological foes.

Runs cold.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The caster suppresses their metabolic output and slows their heart rate to a near-stasis level, causing their blood to "run cold." While active, the hemomancer becomes entirely invisible to thermal sensors, infrared scanning, and tracking mechanisms that seek body heat. Furthermore, they gain a +2 bonus to resistance modifiers against cold-based environmental hazards or attacks, but take a +1 step penalty to initiative action checks.
Runs cold.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Runs cold.name: Runs cold

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the metabolic slowing is so profound that the hemomancer can feign absolute death, bypassing chemical and biological life-sign scans entirely.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the stasis state extends to 1 hour.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the protection increases, allowing the caster to completely ignore normal environmental cold damage hazards.

Runs cold.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 26

Shapechanging.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The alchemist restructures their own atomic composition or that of a touched non-living object, altering its shape, size, and texture. Unlike purely cosmetic illusion skills, this transformation is completely real and physical, shifting the underlying material geometry. If changing their own form, the wizard can assume the physical dimensions and structural properties of another creature or material, though they retain their base mental attributes.
Shapechanging.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (2 FX energy points)
Shapechanging.name: Shapechanging

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the transformation allows the complete acquisition of a single natural physical trait of the assumed form, such as gills or natural armor.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the physical transformation extends to 1 hour.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the caster can safely alter their total mass by up to 50% to take on larger or smaller shapes.

Shapechanging.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 28

Shapeshifting.description: This power allows the hero to alter her size and physical features to appear as another creature within their size range. The hero's clothing and gear do not change shape, so they might not fit the new form. The power grants a -2 step bonus to the Deception-disguise skill. The change is strictly cosmetic—the hero gains no special abilities of the form she takes (e.g., gills, wings). The active form lasts 1 hour.
Shapeshifting.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained.
Shapeshifting.name: Shapeshifting

rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, apply an additional +1 step penalty to perception checks made to see through the disguise.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, this becomes an additional +2 step penalty.

Shapeshifting.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Shrinking.description: Shrinks the hero and all worn or carried gear. Ability Scores remain unchanged, but the hero initially becomes 25 percent of normal height. Nonflying movement rates and lifting capacity are multiplied by the size change. The hero gains +2 to Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers, gains a -3 step bonus to Stealth checks, and all melee damage inflicted by the hero is reduced by 4 points. Mass decreases by the cube of the height decrease. The power lasts 10 minutes and size can be changed within the allowed range without extra FX cost.
Shrinking.meta: Manual: Shrinking; Super Power FX - Body Alteration; Specialty cost 3; Ability CON; Active or 1 FX energy point; cannot be used untrained; Beyond Science p. 60.
Shrinking.name: Shrinking

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, can shrink to 5 percent of normal height, gaining +4 resistance modifiers, -5 steps to Stealth, and -8 damage.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, increased Size Alteration - can shrink to 10 percent of normal height, gaining +3 resistance modifiers, -4 steps to Stealth, and -6 damage.

Signs and portents.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: Manifestations change local environment conditions cosmetically but carry heavy narrative weight. Full Text: This miracle causes obvious signs of the divine to manifest in the area around the priest (e.g., blooming flowers, lights in the sky).
Signs and portents.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (2 FX energy points)
Signs and portents.name: Signs and portents

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, it extends to 1,000 kilometers.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the effects of signs and portents can extend up to 100 meters.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range increases to 10 kilometers.

Signs and portents.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Sleep of Morpheus.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The alchemist utilizes a combination of spoken esoteric formulas and dispersed alchemical powders to induce a profound, unnatural slumber. The caster targets a single living creature with a functioning respiratory system within 10 meters. The target must pass a physical resolve check. On a failure, they fall into a deep, comatose sleep for the duration of the scene. They cannot be awakened by normal noise or mild jostling; it requires actual physical damage or an aggressive neutralizing chemical to break the enchantment.
Sleep of Morpheus.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Sleep of Morpheus.name: Sleep of Morpheus

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the duration of the unnatural slumber extends to 24 hours.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the spell can be cast as a localized 3-meter radius cloud, affecting all breathing targets within the area.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the sleep becomes so incredibly deep that even suffering physical damage only grants the victim a secondary physical resolve check to awaken, rather than breaking the spell automatically.

Sleep of Morpheus.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 29

Speak with dead.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This spell allows the necromancer to temporarily call the spirit of a deceased creature back to its remains (or a place of its death) to answer questions. The spirit retains the knowledge it had in life but is often cryptic, resentful, or confused. The caster can ask one question per degree of success. The spell lasts for 5 minutes.
Speak with dead.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Augur spell (1 FX energy point)
Speak with dead.name: Speak with dead

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the necromancer can call upon spirits without a physical anchor, simply naming the dead entity if they possess a strong personal connection to them.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the necromancer receives a -1 step bonus to Interaction checks made to compel the spirit to speak truthfully.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the duration of the conversation extends to 30 minutes, and the spirit's memory is clearer.

Speak with dead.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Spirit of the beast.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: The shaman actually gains four ranks in a specific specialty skill for 1 full hour. This chosen skill must align with a primal or physical quality of the selected animal spirit (e.g., tracking like a wolf, sneaking like a panther).
Spirit of the beast.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Spirit of the beast.name: Spirit of the beast
Spirit of the beast.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 47

Spiritwrack.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This spell creates a painful resonance that torments beings native to other dimensions, such as demons. The targeted creature is wracked with debilitating pains, suffering an immediate step penalty to all its actions based on the spell's success check.
Spiritwrack.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Spiritwrack.name: Spiritwrack

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the duration of the spell increases, keeping the entity incapacitated for the entire scene unless disrupted.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, any penalty inflicted by this spell increases by +1 step.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the penalty increases by another +1 step.

Spiritwrack.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 23

Static image.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This simple spell creates a completely stationary, three-dimensional visual illusion of an object, creature, or landscape feature within a 2-meter cube up to 30 meters away. The image remains fixed in place and stands up to casual inspection from a distance, but does not adjust to changing light conditions or physical contact.
Static image.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (1 FX energy point)
Static image.name: Static image

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the image incorporates native lighting reflections, automatically adjusting to shift step penalties onto anyone trying to inspect it under low-light or shifting light sources.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the fixed image extends to 1 hour.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the maximum dimension of the static illusion cube expands to 4 meters.

Static image.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 30

Steal the soul.description: Governing Ability: Constitution (CON). Player Notes: This is the most feared spell in the necromancer's arsenal. The caster attempts to literally tear the soul or life essence from a living victim within 5 meters. This is an opposed check against the target's mental and physical resolve. If the spell succeeds, the target falls into a deep coma, and their life essence is captured in a prepared gemstone or receptacle. The victim will die in d4 days if the soul is not returned.
Steal the soul.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (3 FX energy points)
Steal the soul.name: Steal the soul

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the caster permanently absorbs a fraction of the victim's power, temporarily gaining 1 rank in a random broad skill possessed by the victim for 24 hours.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the caster can utilize the stolen soul energy to immediately heal all their own stun and wound damage.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the soul theft increases to 15 meters.

Steal the soul.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 34

Stigmata.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: The hemomancer causes a burst of weaponized blood to spray or weep from their own skin or open wounds, shaping it into a corrosive, toxic mist or a razor-sharp projectile. This attack targets a single opponent within 10 meters, inflicting d4w/d6w/d4m (En/O) damage upon a successful strike. The caster must sacrifice 2 stun points to trigger this invocation.
Stigmata.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (1 FX energy point)
Stigmata.name: Stigmata

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the spray acts as an area-of-effect mist, clouding a 3-meter radius and adding a +1 step penalty to all actions for those caught inside.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the damage increases to d4+1w/d6+1w/d4+1m.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the range of the kinetic blood strike increases to 20 meters.

Stigmata.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 26

Storm of flames.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: This is the pinnacle of the pyromancer's destructive capability. The caster summons a torrential downpour of liquid fire and scorching winds over a targeted 10-meter radius within 30 meters. Everyone caught within the area of effect must make a Dexterity resistance check to avoid the brunt of the blast. The storm inflicts d4w/d6w/d8w (En/O) damage. Highly flammable materials within the area are instantly ignited.
Storm of flames.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Conjure spell (3 FX energy points)
Storm of flames.name: Storm of flames

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, achieving an Amazing success allows the caster to shape the storm, deliberately leaving safe pockets within the inferno to protect allies.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the range of the spell increases to 50 meters, and the area of effect expands to a 15-meter radius.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the intensity of the flames is upgraded, causing the damage to bypass Ordinary armor entirely.

Storm of flames.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 36

Stretching.description: This power gives the hero an extremely malleable body, enabling her to stretch her limbs, body, or neck. She can stretch any of her limbs up to half a meter and can reach objects up to 1 meter away. Since her body is elastic, she takes only half damage from LI attacks. She can snake her arms around corners or through small openings to unlock doors or grab items. The stretching effect lasts up to 10 minutes when activated.
Stretching.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Stretching.name: Stretching

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character can elongate each limb an additional half-meter to a total of 2 meters at rank 12.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character can elongate each limb an additional half-meter.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character can elongate each limb an additional half-meter.

Stretching.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 59

Summoning.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This spell allows the diabolist to tear through dimensional boundaries and pull a specific extra-dimensional creature into the local space. The ritual is complex and typically requires a pre-drawn occult circle to safely contain the entity upon arrival. Without a protective circle, the creature is free to act independently and will likely target the summoner.
Summoning.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Summon spell (2 FX energy points)
Summoning.name: Summoning

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the summoner can open a brief gateway to call forth a major extra-dimensional entity.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the diabolist can accurately summon a specific named minor entity with a -1 step bonus.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the summoning ritual time is reduced from 10 minutes to 1 minute (5 rounds).
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the diabolist can summon up to three minor entities simultaneously.

Summoning.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 24

Super Constitution.description: This power increases the character's physical fitness and overall toughness. The character's Constitution is increased by 1 point even if this takes the character above a racial maximum. Durability and all abilities and statistics based upon Constitution should be altered to reflect this new value. The character also gains 1 additional stun point. This change lasts 10 minutes.
Super Constitution.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Super Constitution.name: Super Constitution

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's Constitution and stun points increase by 1. The Constitution increase affects all skills and abilities based on Constitution.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's Constitution and stun points increase by 1. The Constitution increase affects all skills and abilities based on Constitution.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's Constitution and stun points increase by 1. The Constitution increase affects all skills and abilities based on Constitution.

Super Constitution.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 62

Super Dexterity.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Increases base Dexterity by 1 point. Directly adds +1 point to the character's core action check score. Lasts 10 minutes. This power increases the character's agility and reflexes. The character's Dexterity is increased by 1 point even if this takes the character above a racial maximum. All abilities and statistics based on Dexterity should be altered to reflect this new value.
Super Dexterity.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Super Dexterity.name: Super Dexterity

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's Dexterity increases by 1 (affecting all skills and abilities based on Dexterity), and the hero gains an additional 1 point to her action check score.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's Dexterity increases by 1 (affecting all skills and abilities based on Dexterity), and the hero gains an additional 1 point to her action check score.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's Dexterity increases by 1 (affecting all skills and abilities based on Dexterity), and the hero gains an additional 1 point to her action check score.

Super Dexterity.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 69

Super Intelligence.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Modifies the character's base stats by adding 1 point to Intelligence. Grants a -1 step bonus to any Intelligence-based complex skill checks (excluding mindwalking or FX skills). No additional skill points are gained unless active always and chosen at creation. Power lasts for 10 minutes. This power increases the hero's mental quickness and learning ability. The hero's Intelligence increases by 1 point even if this takes the character above a racial maximum. All abilities and statistics based on Intelligence should be altered to reflect this new value.
Super Intelligence.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Super Intelligence.name: Super Intelligence

rank_benefits.12: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the number of successes for any Intelligence-based complex skill check except for those based on mindwalking or FX skills is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 2.
rank_benefits.4: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the character's Intelligence increases by 1. The Intelligence increase affects all skills and abilities based on Intelligence. However, the hero gains no additional skill points from any of these increases.
rank_benefits.8: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the character's Intelligence increases by 1. The Intelligence increase affects all skills and abilities based on Intelligence. However, the hero gains no additional skill points from any of these increases.

Super Intelligence.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 67

Super Personality.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Modifies base stats by adding 1 point to Personality. Grants a -1 step bonus to Personality feat checks made to determine a target's starting attitude. Power lasts for 10 minutes. This power increases the hero's social abilities and charisma. The hero's Personality increases by 1 point even if this takes the character above a racial maximum. All abilities and statistics based on Personality should be altered to reflect this new value.
Super Personality.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Super Personality.name: Super Personality

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, all initial reactions are Charmed. Remember that the hero's actions can cause a target's attitude to drop below this level—only the initial impression is affected.
rank_benefits.4: At ranks 4, 8, and 12, the character's Personality increases by 1. The Personality increase affects all skills and abilities based on Personality.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 4, the hero's presence causes starting attitudes of supporting cast members to be shifted one column to the right, to a maximum of Charmed, on TABLE P25: ENCOUNTER SKILL EFFECTS in the Player's Handbook. Thus, targets who would normally be Hostile to the hero begin as Neutral instead.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the Gamemaster should shift initial reactions two columns to the right (Hostile to Friendly, and all others to Charmed).

Super Personality.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 67

Super Strength.description: This power increases the character's physical power and muscle. The character's Strength is increased by 1 point even if this takes the character above a racial maximum. Movement rate and all abilities and statistics based upon Strength should be altered to reflect this new value. The hero can also lift twice as much weight as his Strength would normally allow. (See the Lifting Objects section in Chapter 4: Skills in the Gamemaster Guide.) This power lasts 10 minutes for each use.
Super Strength.meta: Active or 1 FX energy point. This skill can't be used untrained. No skill check required.
Super Strength.name: Super Strength

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, strength increases by another 1 and lifting/moving increases to x5.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, improved Strength - Strength increases by another 1, and Strength for lifting or moving heavy objects increases to x3.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, strength increases by another 1 and lifting/moving increases to x4.

Super Strength.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 62-63

Super Will.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Modifies base stats by adding 1 point to Will. Grants a +1 bonus to resistance modifiers against FX or psionics that target or affect the mind. Power lasts for 10 minutes. This power increases the hero's mental fortitude and intuitive capacity. The hero's Will is increased by 1 point even if this takes the character above a racial maximum. All abilities and statistics based on Will should be altered to reflect this new value.
Super Will.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Super Will.name: Super Will

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's Will increases by 1. The Will increase affects all skills and abilities based on Will. The hero also gains an additional +1 to her resistance modifier against FX or psionics that affect the mind.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the character's Will increases by 1. The Will increase affects all skills and abilities based on Will. The hero also gains an additional +1 to her resistance modifier against FX or psionics that affect the mind.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the character's Will increases by 1. The Will increase affects all skills and abilities based on Will. The hero also gains an additional +1 to her resistance modifier against FX or psionics that affect the mind.

Super Will.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 67

Superior Senses.description: Enhances all senses to a superhuman level. In general, the hero gains a -1 step bonus to any skill check or reduces a sensory-related penalty by one step where improved senses help, such as Manipulation, Awareness-perception, Investigate-search, tracking, poor visibility, or poor illumination. The power lasts 1 hour per degree of success. Attacks specifically targeting the hero's senses, such as bright light or loud noise, gain a bonus equal to the hero's sensory bonus. At acquisition, the player may choose to enhance only one sense, reducing versatility but granting an additional -1 step bonus to that sense, such as -2 for sight-related perception.
Superior Senses.meta: Manual: Superior Senses; Super Power FX - Metaconscious; Specialty cost 3; Ability WIL; Active or 1 FX energy point; cannot be used untrained; Beyond Science p. 67.
Superior Senses.name: Superior Senses

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, improves by another 1 step.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, improved Sensitivity - the bonus for all affected senses improves by 1 step.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, improves by another 1 step.

Surge of greenery.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Entanglement Penalties: Moving through the mutating growth requires an Acrobatics-dodge or Movement-trailblazing check to avoid being pinned. Short grass cuts movement by 25%, long grass cuts it by 50%, and heavy brush completely halts all transit. Full Text: This miracle charges plant life within a 20-meter radius with vital energy, triggering hyper-accelerated growth. Plants surge by one month's normal development per skill rank. Lawn grass caps out at 50 cm, but crops/wild grasses rocket past 2 meters; thickets intertwine instantly, and saplings mature drastically, providing heavy cover.
Surge of greenery.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Surge of greenery.name: Surge of greenery
Surge of greenery.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 41

Swords into plowshares.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This effect ends immediately for any individual who undertakes a hostile action. Full Text: This miracle inflicts a +2 step penalty to all hostile actions taken by any individuals within 10 meters of the priest. A hostile action is considered to be any action the person to be affected would consider harmful or dangerous. In addition, any individual in this area who does not attempt a hostile action gains +1 to her Strength and Dexterity resistance modifiers. Swords into plowshares lasts for 1 minute (5 rounds).
Swords into plowshares.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Swords into plowshares.name: Swords into plowshares
Swords into plowshares.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Talisman.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This permits the storage of specific spiritual protections or triggers into a localized physical anchor, usually a paper strip or carved tablet. Full Text: The priest transcribes a precise divine pattern onto a physical talisman, anchoring a fraction of their spiritual energy into the object. The talisman can then be attached to a person, doorway, or container to ward off malicious spirits, hexes, or unexpected environmental hazards. The item remains charged until triggered or until the scene concludes.
Talisman.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Conjure miracle (1 FX energy point)
Talisman.name: Talisman

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the talisman's protective ward scales to an area effect, shielding an entire 3-meter room or entryway from minor supernatural entries.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the talisman remains active for up to 24 hours before naturally discharging its energy.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the priest can imprint an active trigger that releases a minor burst of energy damage (d4 stun) if an unauthorized entity touches it.

Talisman.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 53

Teleportation.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: Base weight capacity limits transportation to the character and about 50 kilograms of material. Arriving at a spot occupied by a solid object displaces the character up to 10 meters and inflicts 1 point of fatigue damage. If no open space exists within 10 meters, the teleportation fails completely, and the hero suffers 1 point of fatigue damage. This power allows the character to move from one point in space to another without crossing the distance between them. The character can travel up to 1 kilometer with each use of this power. The target location must be familiar to the character.
Teleportation.meta: Cost: 5 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / 1 FX energy point (No skill check required)
Teleportation.name: Teleportation

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's teleportation distance and the cargo he can carry increases to 10,000 kilometers and 800 kilograms.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the character's teleportation distance and the cargo he can carry increases to 10 kilometers and 100 kilograms.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the character's teleportation distance and the cargo he can carry increases to 100 kilometers and 200 kilograms.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the character's teleportation distance and the cargo he can carry increases to 1,000 kilometers and 400 kilograms.

Teleportation.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 69

Thicker than water.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: By utilizing their own blood as a sympathetic mystical conduit, the hemomancer establishes a deep biological and spiritual bond with chosen allies. The caster sheds a few drops of blood to anoint up to three willing targets within 5 meters. For the duration of the scene, any beneficial FX healing, physiological buffs, or resistance modifiers applied to the hemomancer are automatically shared with the bonded allies at no additional FX energy cost.
Thicker than water.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 FX energy point)
Thicker than water.name: Thicker than water

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the bond is so strong that it prevents bonded allies from bleeding out; any ally dropping to 0 wound points stabilizes automatically without needing a Constitution feat check.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the duration of the blood bond extends to 24 hours.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the hemomancer can actively siphon fatigue or stun damage away from a bonded ally and absorb it themselves as a free action.

Thicker than water.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 20

Tongue of the damned.description: Governing Ability: Personality (PER). Player Notes: This spell allows the diabolist to reach across the dimensional veil and contact a demonic intelligence or extra-dimensional entity to seek hidden information or answer specific questions. The degree of success grants a corresponding -1, -2, or -3 step bonus, representing the caster's ability to locate a specific demonic intelligence that is more likely to be able to accurately answer the particular questions posed. Critical Failure Warning: Diabolism carries immense risk. If a Critical Failure is rolled on the skill check, the demon becomes irritated by the diabolist's questioning and actively attempts to possess the caster. If the demon is communicating through a physical anchor or object, it will spell out a terrifying prediction to those watching, violently hurl the object across the room, and then attempt the possession.
Tongue of the damned.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Augur spell (1 FX energy point)
Tongue of the damned.name: Tongue of the damned

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the diabolist can safely contact major fiendish intelligences without the risk of immediate possession on a standard Failure (though a Critical Failure still carries grave consequences).
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the diabolist can ask an additional question per invocation and gains a +1 bonus to their resistance modifier against any possession attempts triggered by a Critical Failure.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the spell can be cast to identify the true name of a minor extra-dimensional entity that the caster is currently observing.

Tongue of the damned.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 24

Tongue of the infinite stars.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Modifiers: Anyone within 10 meters of the miracle's area must make a Resolve-mental resolve skill check with a -2 step bonus or suffer the temporary effects of a Critical Failure on an Alienism miracle check (gain one flaw and lose 1 point of Intelligence for d4 days). If used as an attack against a creature within 30 meters, the target must make a mental resolve check or suffer the same temporary effects (precludes translation effect). This miracle allows open communication between all intelligent creatures within 30 meters of the alienist. All such creatures communicate as if they were speaking the same language, regardless of native form (crystalline entity flashes, volcanic heat patterns, telepathy, etc.). The miracle actually translates each creature's language into a bizarre alien universal language while simultaneously allowing the recipients to comprehend it. Anyone outside the area hears nothing but a strange chaotic babble. The translation ability lasts 1 minute plus 1 minute per degree of success.
Tongue of the infinite stars.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform miracle (1 FX energy point)
Tongue of the infinite stars.name: Tongue of the Infinite Stars

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the translation ability of the miracle lasts an additional minute.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the translation ability of the miracle lasts an additional minute.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the translation ability of the miracle lasts an additional minute.

Tongue of the infinite stars.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 39

Trance visions.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This miracle allows the shaman to gain a glimpse of the future, although this vision is altered by the perceptions of the spirits that bring it. The GM delivers these visions in heavily symbolic or enigmatic terms.
Trance visions.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Augur miracle (1 FX energy point)
Trance visions.name: Trance visions
Trance visions.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 47

Transmutation.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This carefully guarded spell allows the alchemist to transform one substance into another via a complex extended ritual. The wizard reorders the molecular structure of an object, turning lead to gold, stone to wood, or steel to glass. The base material mass that can be reordered scales explicitly based on the alchemist's rank.
Transmutation.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Transform spell (1 or 2 FX energy points)
Transmutation.name: Transmutation

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the alchemist can transmute up to 5 kilograms of matter.
rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, the alchemist can transmute up to 1 kilogram of matter.
rank_benefits.8: At rank 8, the alchemist can transmute up to 3 kilograms of matter.

Transmutation.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 29

Venom spirit.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: This miracle allows the shaman to summon and direct leechlike spirit creatures to attack the life energy of an enemy, slowly draining their durability scores or delivering spiritual poisons.
Venom spirit.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Summon miracle (1 FX energy point)
Venom spirit.name: Venom spirit
Venom spirit.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 47

Vision.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Player Notes: Symbolic dreams or immediate mental images are undeniable in clarity but remain open to interpretation. Full Text: Visions are signs from the divine that are often enigmatic or symbolic but that leave no question as to their truth or origin. The priest might be granted a vision directly or in a dream.
Vision.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Augur miracle (2 FX energy points)
Vision.name: Vision

rank_benefits.4: At rank 4, higher ranks solidify the enigmatic scenes into clear future timestamps, exact target locations, and concrete paths to follow.

Vision.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 45

Voices in the grass and sky.description: Governing Ability: Intelligence (INT). Player Notes: Form 1 (Flora Link): Requires living plants. Can read back 1 hour into the past per skill rank. Form 2 (Astrology): Requires star-tracking instruments (sacred standing stones preferred). Predicts relevant events up to 1 week in advance per skill rank. Cannot read portents for distant lands/planets unless they hold a direct, impending impact on the druid. Full Text: This miracle permits communication with plants or reads the cosmos to interpret the future. The flora path mirrors ESP-postcognition and ESP-psychometry traits, translating a plant’s simple sensory impression of its environment into human comprehension. The cosmic path delivers prophecies: Ordinary success yields vague archetypes (victory, tragedy, war); Good success outlines specific contexts (negotiation win, war with a specific clan); Amazing success reveals the event, context, and symbolic descriptors identifying the exact target.
Voices in the grass and sky.meta: Cost: 3 skill points / Untrained use not specified / Augur miracle (1 FX energy point)
Voices in the grass and sky.name: Voices in the grass and sky
Voices in the grass and sky.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 41-42

Wallcrawling.description: Governing Ability: Will (WIL). Modifiers: The gripping strength of this power is equal to the hero's own Strength Ability Score, meaning external forces exceeding this score can detach the character from the surface. Lasts 10 minutes per use. This power allows the hero to move along horizontal or vertical surfaces without penalty at her normal movement rate. The hero can walk, run, or sprint up a wall or hang upside down from a ceiling without fear of falling or the need for handholds. This power can also be used to hold onto smaller solid objects, such as ropes, weapons, or other equipment.
Wallcrawling.meta: Cost: 2 skill points / This skill can't be used untrained / Active or 1 FX energy point
Wallcrawling.name: Wallcrawling

rank_benefits.12: At rank 12, the character's Strength Ability Score is considered to be 1 point higher for the purpose of holding on with this power.
rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the character's Strength Ability Score is considered to be 1 point higher for the purpose of holding on with this power.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, the character's Strength Ability Score is considered to be 1 point higher for the purpose of holding on with this power.
rank_benefits.9: At rank 9, the character's Strength Ability Score is considered to be 1 point higher for the purpose of holding on with this power.

Wallcrawling.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pg. 69

Wield the ley line.description: This miracle channels the energy of the earth. It gives the druid the ability to lift a heavy object weighing up to 100 kilograms into the air and move it about at a combat movement rate of 1.
Wield the ley line.name: Wield the ley line

rank_benefits.3: At rank 3, the druid can move an object weighing up to 400 kilograms... This limit increases to 2,700 kilograms.
rank_benefits.6: At rank 6, 6,400 kilograms.

Befriend.description: Improved charm shifting a target's attitude by 1, 2, or 3 categories (can adjust even Hostile/Combative targets toward Fanatic). Lasts 1 hour.
Befriend.meta: Cost: 4 skill points / Energy: 1 FX point / Range: 2 meters / Duration: 1 hour
Befriend.name: Befriend

rank_benefits.4: Affects 3 targets simultaneously.
rank_benefits.8: Affects 10 targets simultaneously.
rank_benefits.12: Affects 30 targets simultaneously.

Befriend.source: Beyond Science: A Guide to FX, pgs. 28-30
